throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"Unexpected status {(int)putResp.StatusCode} for PUT without auth. Response: {putResp.Content}");
}

 [Theory(DisplayName = "API-28 - Update Room without valid Data")]
 [InlineData("emptyRoomName")]
 [InlineData("emptyType")]
 [InlineData("accessibleAsNumber")]
 [InlineData("hugePrice")]
 [InlineData("missingFeatures")]
 public async Task UpdateRoom_WithInvalidData_ReturnsClientError(string caseId)
 {
     Output.Should().NotBeNull();
     // Arrange — create a valid room and obtain auth token
     var room = RoomFactory.Create();
     var auth = new AutomationTestingAuthClient();
     var token = await auth.GetTokenAsync("admin", "password");
     token.Should().NotBeNullOrWhiteSpace();

     var client = ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase);
     var roomClient = new RoomClient(client);
     var createResp = await roomClient.CreateRoomAsync(room, token);
     BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, "POST /api/room", createResp);
     createResp.StatusCode.Should().BeOneOf(HttpStatusCode.OK, HttpStatusCode.Created);

     // discover created room id
     var listResp = await client.ExecuteAsync(new RestRequest("room", Method.Get).AddHeader("Cookie", $"token={token}"));
     BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, "GET /room", listResp);
     listResp.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
     using var listDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(listResp.Content!);
     listDoc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("rooms", out var roomsEl).Should().BeTrue();
     int roomId = -1;
     foreach (var r in roomsEl.EnumerateArray())
     {
         if (r.TryGetProperty("roomName", out var rn) && rn.GetString() == room.RoomName
             && r.TryGetProperty("roomid", out var rid) && rid.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number)
         {
             roomId = rid.GetInt32();
             break;
         }
     }
     roomId.Should().BeGreaterThan(0);

     // build invalid payload based on case
     object updatedPayload = caseId switch
     {
         "emptyRoomName" => new
         {
             roomName = "",
             type = room.Type,
             accessible = room.Accessible,
             image = room.Image,
             description = room.Description,
             roomPrice = room.RoomPrice,
             features = room.Features
         },
         "emptyType" => new
         {
             roomName = room.RoomName,
             type = "",
             accessible = room.Accessible,
             image = room.Image,
             description = room.Description,
             roomPrice = room.RoomPrice,
             features = room.Features
         },
         "accessibleAsNumber" => new
         {
             roomName = room.RoomName,
             type = room.Type,
             accessible = 0, // invalid type
             image = room.Image,
             description = room.Description,
             roomPrice = room.RoomPrice,
             features = room.Features
         },
         "hugePrice" => new
         {
             roomName = room.RoomName,
             type = room.Type,
             accessible = room.Accessible,
             image = room.Image,
             description = room.Description,
             roomPrice = 8_000_000,
             features = room.Features
         },
         "missingFeatures" => new
         {
             roomName = room.RoomName,
             type = room.Type,
             accessible = room.Accessible,
             image = room.Image,
             description = room.Description,
             roomPrice = room.RoomPrice,
             // features omitted via null
             features = (string[]?)null
         },
         _ => throw new InvalidOperationException(caseId)
     };

     var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(updatedPayload, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase });

     // Act - PUT /room/{id} with auth
     var putReq = new RestRequest($"room/{roomId}", Method.Put)
         .AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
         .AddHeader("Cookie", $"token={token}")
         .AddStringBody(json, "application/json");

     var putResp = await client.ExecuteAsync(putReq);
     BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, $"PUT /room/{roomId} - case {caseId}", putResp);

     // Assert - expect 4xx client error; 500 => fail for triage; if 2xx then cleanup and fail
     var code = (int)putResp.StatusCode;
     if (code >= 400 && code < 500)
     {
         code.Should().BeInRange(400, 499);
         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(putResp.Content) && putResp.Content.TrimStart().StartsWith("{"))
         {
             using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(putResp.Content!);
             // prefer an errors array
             if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("errors", out var errorsEl) && errorsEl.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
                 errorsEl.EnumerateArray().Should().NotBeEmpty();
         }
         return;
     }

     if (code >= 200 && code < 300)
     {
         // cleanup created room then fail
         try
         {
             await roomClient.DeleteRoomAsync(roomId, token);
         }
         catch { /* best-effort */ }

         throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"Server accepted invalid update for case '{caseId}'. Status: {code}. Response: {putResp.Content}");
     }

     if (code >= 500)
         throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"Server error for invalid update (case '{caseId}'). Status: {code}. Response: {putResp.Content}");

     throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"Unexpected status {code} for case '{caseId}'. Response: {putResp.Content}");
 }

createResp.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);

// Find created room id
var listResp = await roomClient.GetRoomsAsync(token);
BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, "GET /room", listResp);
listResp.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
using var listDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(listResp.Content!);
listDoc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("rooms", out var roomsEl).Should().BeTrue();
var created = roomsEl.EnumerateArray()
    .FirstOrDefault(r => r.TryGetProperty("roomName", out var rn) && rn.GetString() == room.RoomName);
created.ValueKind.Should().Be(JsonValueKind.Object);
var roomId = created.GetProperty("roomid").GetInt32();
Output.WriteLine($"Created room id: {roomId}");

// Act: attempt DELETE without auth (no token)
var client = ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase);
var deleteReq = new RestRequest($"room/{roomId}", Method.Delete)
    .AddHeader("Accept", "*/*");
var deleteResp = await client.ExecuteAsync(deleteReq);
BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, $"DELETE /room/{roomId} (no auth)", deleteResp);

// Assert: expect 401/403 or other 4xx; fail if 2xx
if (deleteResp.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized || deleteResp.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
{
    deleteResp.StatusCode.Should().BeOneOf(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, HttpStatusCode.Forbidden);
}
else if ((int)deleteResp.StatusCode >= 400 && (int)deleteResp.StatusCode < 500)
{
    ((int)deleteResp.StatusCode).Should().BeInRange(400, 499);
}
else if (deleteResp.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK)
{
    throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"DELETE without auth unexpectedly succeeded (200). Response: {deleteResp.Content}");
}
else
{
    throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"Unexpected status {(int)deleteResp.StatusCode} for unauthenticated delete. Response: {deleteResp.Content}");
}

// Verify room still exists (GET may require auth)
var getResp = await roomClient.GetRoomAsync(roomId);
BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, $"GET /room/{roomId} after failed delete", getResp);

if (getResp.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK)
{
    using var getDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(getResp.Content!);
    getDoc.RootElement.GetProperty("roomName").GetString().Should().Be(room.RoomName);
}
else if (getResp.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized || getResp.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
{
    Output.WriteLine($"GET /room/{roomId} requires auth (status {(int)getResp.StatusCode}); cannot verify content but delete was rejected.");
}
else
{
    throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"Unexpected status {(int)getResp.StatusCode} when verifying room after failed delete. Response: {getResp.Content}");
}

// Cleanup: remove room using auth
try
{
    var delCleanup = await roomClient.DeleteRoomAsync(roomId, token);
    BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(Output, $"DELETE /room/{roomId} (cleanup)", delCleanup);
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    Output.WriteLine($"Cleanup failed: {ex.Message}");
}
}

Notas / recomendações

Instale Selenium.WebDriver + Selenium.WebDriver.ChromeDriver packages.
For CI, prefer headless Chrome; locally remove headless for debugging.
Consider using WebDriverManager (or maintain chromedriver matching Chrome).
Use explicit waits (WebDriverWait) rather than heavy implicit waits for reliability.
Add a UI/Fixtures/TestBase to share setup (screenshots on failure, logs).
Keep selectors centralized in Page Objects; tests should call page methods (arrange/act/assert).
Se quiser, eu gero:

A versão com WebDriverWait helpers,
Screenshot-on-failure in fixture,
A sample interactive test that fills and submits the booking form using real selectors (paste homepage HTML or confirm selectors). Qual prefere?
using System;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Chrome;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Firefox;

namespace UI.Tests.Helpers
{
    public enum BrowserType
    {
        Chrome,
        Firefox
    }
    public class WebDriverOptions
    {
        public BrowserType Browser { get; set; } = BrowserType.Chrome;
        public bool Headless { get; set; } = false;
        public int ImplicitWaitSeconds { get; set; } = 5;
    }

    public static class WebDriverFactory
    {
        public static IWebDriver Create(WebDriverOptions options)
        {
            if (options == null) options = new WebDriverOptions();

            IWebDriver driver = options.Browser switch
            {
                BrowserType.Firefox => CreateFirefox(options.Headless),
                _ => CreateChrome(options.Headless)
            };

            driver.Manage().Timeouts().ImplicitWait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(options.ImplicitWaitSeconds);
            driver.Manage().Window.Maximize();
            return driver;
        }

        private static IWebDriver CreateChrome(bool headless)
        {
            var chromeOptions = new ChromeOptions();
            if (headless)
            {
                chromeOptions.AddArgument("--headless=new"); // or "--headless" for older versions
                chromeOptions.AddArgument("--disable-gpu");
            }
            chromeOptions.AddArgument("--no-sandbox");
            chromeOptions.AddArgument("--disable-dev-shm-usage");
            return new ChromeDriver(chromeOptions);
        }

        private static IWebDriver CreateFirefox(bool headless)
        {
            var firefoxOptions = new FirefoxOptions();
            if (headless)
            {
                firefoxOptions.AddArgument("--headless");
            }
            firefoxOptions.SetPreference("dom.webnotifications.enabled", false);
            return new FirefoxDriver(firefoxOptions);
        }
    }
}
essa minha classe helpers.WebDriverFactory eu posso manter ?

Sim — pode manter. A implementação está boa e flexível. Algumas recomendações práticas rápidas para torná‑la mais robusta em CI/produção:

Garanta que chromedriver/geckodriver estejam disponíveis no PATH ou forneça o caminho ao ChromeDriver/FirefoxDriver (ou use WebDriverManager).
Em headless use WindowSize em vez de Maximize (Maximize pode não funcionar em headless): if (headless) driver.Manage().Window.Size = new Size(1366, 768); else driver.Manage().Window.Maximize();
Oculte a janela do serviço do driver (opcional): ChromeDriverService.CreateDefaultService().HideCommandPromptWindow = true;
Adicione tratamento para fechar e Dispose do driver no teardown (IAsyncLifetime / IClassFixture).
Considere expor capability para executar remoto (Selenium Grid / Selenoid) no futuro.
Configuretimeouts explícitos: ImplicitWait + prefer Explicit Wait (WebDriverWait) nos testes.
Se precisar, permita configurar opções via Environment Variables (BROWSER, HEADLESS) na factory.
Se quiser, eu incorporo essas melhorias na sua classe e adiciono um IClassFixture de exemplo para uso nos testes. Quer que eu faça isso?

using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Chrome;
using Xunit;

public class WebDriverFixture : IDisposable
{
    public IWebDriver Driver { get; }
    public WebDriverFixture()
    {
        var options = new ChromeOptions();
        options.AddArgument("--headless=new"); // remove headless for debugging
        options.AddArgument("--no-sandbox");
        options.AddArgument("--disable-dev-shm-usage");
        Driver = new ChromeDriver(options);
        Driver.Manage().Timeouts().ImplicitWait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try { Driver.Quit(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        Driver.Dispose();
    }
}
precisa alterar alguma coisa aqui no webdriverfixture já que estamos usando chrome, firefox e headless no webdriverfactory?

Sim — recomendo adaptar o fixture para usar sua WebDriverFactory e expor configurações (browser, headless, implicit wait), em vez de criar diretamente um ChromeDriver. Isso permite reusar a mesma factory, testar em Firefox e controlar headless via variáveis de ambiente/CI.

Substitua o fixture por algo assim:

using OpenQA.Selenium;
using Xunit;
using UI.Tests.Helpers;

public class WebDriverFixture : IDisposable
{
    public IWebDriver Driver { get; }

text

Collapse


 Copy

public WebDriverFixture()
{
    // Read env vars (optional) to choose browser/headless in CI
    var browser = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("UI_BROWSER")?.ToLowerInvariant() == "firefox"
        ? BrowserType.Firefox
        : BrowserType.Chrome;
    var headless = (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("UI_HEADLESS") ?? "true").ToLowerInvariant() == "true";
    var wait = int.TryParse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("UI_IMPLICIT_WAIT"), out var w) ? w : 5;

    var options = new WebDriverOptions
    {
        Browser = browser,
        Headless = headless,
        ImplicitWaitSeconds = wait
    };

    Driver = WebDriverFactory.Create(options);
}

public void Dispose()
{
    try { Driver.Quit(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    try { Driver.Dispose(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
}
}

Benefícios:

Single source of WebDriver creation (uses your factory).
Configurable via env vars (UI_BROWSER, UI_HEADLESS, UI_IMPLICIT_WAIT).
Works for Chrome/Firefox and headless or headed modes.
No other changes needed in tests (inject fixture via IClassFixture).

A classe está ok como ponto de partida, mas recomendo pequenas melhorias para torná‑la mais robusta e reutilizável em testes reais:

Sugestões práticas (implementar pelo menos as 1–4):

Use waits explicitos em vez de acessar FindElement direto (evita flakiness):
Injetar ou criar um WebDriverWait e usar Wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementIsVisible(...)) antes de usar o elemento.
Não exponha IWebElement diretamente — forneça métodos/ações:
Em vez de public IWebElement Header, exponha bool IsHeaderVisible() ou IWebElement FindHeader() que usa wait.
Trate exceções e retorne resultados claros:
Métodos como IsLoaded() devem logar/expor motivo (por que falhou) e usar um timeout.
Parametrize path/route:
Permita navegar para um caminho específico: GoTo(string path = "") => Navigate to baseUrl + path.
Seletores resilientes:
Preferir IDs/data-* ou text-based selectors em vez de genéricos (header, booking-form) e centralizar os seletores como constantes.
Actions should return page objects / fluent API:
Ex.: FillBookingForm(...) return this; SubmitBooking() return new BookingConfirmationPage(_driver, _url).
Add screenshot on failure (optional) — integrate with fixture.
Minimal refactor example (implements 1–4):

Add private WebDriverWait (5–10s).
Replace direct FindElement usages with wait-based methods.
Update IsLoaded to wait for a stable element.

    private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
    private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
    private readonly string _baseUrl;
    private readonly TimeSpan _timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

text

Collapse


 Copy

// Selectors centralized
private const string HeaderSelector = "header";
private const string BookingFormId = "booking-form";
private const string FirstNameSelector = "input[name='firstname']";
private const string LastNameSelector = "input[name='lastname']";
private const string SubmitButtonSelector = "button[type='submit']";

public HomePage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
{
    _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
    _baseUrl = (baseUrl ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(baseUrl))).TrimEnd('/');
    _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? _timeout);
}

public void GoTo(string path = "")
{
    var url = string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) ? _baseUrl : $"{_baseUrl}/{path.TrimStart('/')}";
    _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl(url);
}

public bool IsLoaded()
{
    try
    {
        GoTo();
        return _wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementIsVisible(By.CssSelector(HeaderSelector))).Displayed;
    }
    catch
    {
        return false;
    }
}

// Wait and return header text (safe accessor)
public string GetHeaderText()
{
    var el = _wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementIsVisible(By.CssSelector(HeaderSelector)));
    return el.Text ?? string.Empty;
}

public bool IsBookingFormPresent()
{
    try
    {
        _wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementExists(By.Id(BookingFormId)));
        return true;
    }
    catch
    {
        return false;
    }
}

// Fills booking fields using waits; returns true if fields were filled
public bool FillBookingForm(string firstname, string lastname)
{
    try
    {
        var first = _wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementIsVisible(By.CssSelector(FirstNameSelector)));
        var last = _wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementIsVisible(By.CssSelector(LastNameSelector)));

        first.Clear();
        first.SendKeys(firstname ?? string.Empty);

        last.Clear();
        last.SendKeys(lastname ?? string.Empty);

        return true;
    }
    catch
    {
        return false;
    }
}

// Click submit and optionally wait for a post-submit condition (locator or timeout)
public bool SubmitBooking(By? postSubmitCondition = null, int waitSeconds = 10)
{
    try
    {
        var btn = _wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementToBeClickable(By.CssSelector(SubmitButtonSelector)));
        btn.Click();

        if (postSubmitCondition is not null)
        {
            var postWait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(waitSeconds));
            postWait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementExists(postSubmitCondition));
        }

        return true;
    }
    catch
    {
        return false;
    }
}

// Utility: take screenshot (caller responsible for saving path)
public Screenshot TakeScreenshot() => ((ITakesScreenshot)_driver).GetScreenshot();
}

O nome "ExpectedConditions" não existe no contexto atual

O erro ocorre porque ExpectedConditions não faz parte do núcleo do Selenium WebDriver — ele está no pacote Selenium.Support/Extras. Soluções rápidas:

Adicione o pacote Selenium.Support + Selenium.Support.Extensions (SeleniumExtras) via NuGet:
dotnet add package Selenium.Support
dotnet add package Selenium.WebDriver.ChromeDriver
dotnet add package Selenium.WebDriver.Extensions.WaitHelpers (ou Selenium.Support + Selenium.WebDriver)
Mais simples e usual:

dotnet add package Selenium.Support
dotnet add package Selenium.WebDriver
dotnet add package Selenium.WebDriver.ChromeDriver
dotnet add package SeleniumExtras.WaitHelpers
No topo da classe inclua:
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;
using SeleniumExtras.WaitHelpers;

Alternativa sem ExpectedConditions (se não quiser pacote extra), use lambdas with WebDriverWait:
_wait.Until(d => d.FindElement(By.CssSelector(HeaderSelector)).Displayed);

Exemplo mínimo corrigido (imports + one method) — substitua os usings e as chamadas ExpectedConditions por Wait.Until lambdas if you prefer not to add SeleniumExtras:

using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;
using SeleniumExtras.WaitHelpers; // ensure package SeleniumExtras.WaitHelpers is installed

// ... inside methods:
_wait.Until(ExpectedConditions.ElementIsVisible(By.CssSelector(HeaderSelector)));

Or without SeleniumExtras:

_wait.Until(d => d.FindElement(By.CssSelector(HeaderSelector)).Displayed);

Escolha a opção (instalar pacote + using, ou substituir por lambdas). Quer que eu mostre a classe HomePage já atualizada sem ExpectedConditions (usando lambdas) so it compiles sem pacotes extras?

        var options = new WebDriverOptions
        {
            Browser = browser,
            Headless = headless,
            ImplicitWaitSeconds = wait
        };

        Driver = WebDriverFactory.Create(options);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try { Driver.Quit(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        try { Driver.Dispose(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
}

como eu acho o cssSelector para esse botão ? 

Ótimo — pela captura o elemento é:
Book Now

Selecionadores CSS úteis (do mais específico/recomendado para o mais genérico):

Por id/âncora (mais simples e robusto se href único):
a[href="#booking"]

Por classe(s) (encadeando classes):
a.btn.btn-primary.btn-lg

Por texto (não há seletor CSS nativo por texto — use XPath):
//a[text()="Book Now"]

Combinação (seguro se houver mais elementos semelhantes):
a.btn.btn-primary.btn-lg[href="#booking"]

Exemplos de uso em Selenium (C#):

Encontrar e clicar com CSS:
var btn = driver.FindElement(By.CssSelector("a[href="#booking"]"));
btn.Click();

Ou por classes:
var btn = driver.FindElement(By.CssSelector("a.btn.btn-primary.btn-lg"));
btn.Click();

Ou XPath por texto:
var btn = driver.FindElement(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space() = 'Book Now']"));
btn.Click();

Recomendações:

Prefira id/atributo único (a[href="#booking"]) ou combinação de classes + href para maior estabilidade.
Use explicit wait (WebDriverWait) até o elemento ficar clicável antes de clicar.
a.btn.btn-primary.btn-lg[href="#booking"] quero usar essa chave combinada

Use o seletor combinado e um wait explícito antes de clicar. Exemplo pronto para colar na sua Page Object (HomePage):

public void ClickBookNow(int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    var selector = "a.btn.btn-primary.btn-lg[href="#booking"]";
    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));
    var el = wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            var e = d.FindElement(By.CssSelector(selector));
            return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    });
    el.Click();
}

Exemplo de uso no teste:

_home.GoTo();
_home.ClickBookNow(); // irá esperar até 10s e clicar

Notas:

Ajuste timeoutSeconds se precisar de mais tempo.
Se preferir XPath por texto, use: By.XPath("//a[normalize-space() = 'Book Now']").
Se o clique dispara navegação dinâmica, aguarde a condição pós-clique (ex.: elemento do formulário visível) antes de prosseguir.

Use a forma que não depende de ScreenshotImageFormat: obtenha o screenshot como bytes e escreva no ficheiro. Isso evita problemas de referência e funciona com qualquer versão do Selenium.

Substitua o bloco de captura por:

try
{
    var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)driver).GetScreenshot();
    var file = $"homepage_failed{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.png";
    System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(file, ss.AsByteArray);
    Console.WriteLine($"IsLoaded failed: {ex.Message}. Screenshot saved to {file}. Current URL: {_driver.Url}");
}
catch (Exception ex2)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"IsLoaded failed and screenshot capture also failed: {ex.Message}; screenshot error: {ex2.Message}");
}

Isto elimina a necessidade de ScreenshotImageFormat e deverá compilar e gravar a imagem corretamente.

Use XPath que primeiro localiza o card cuja title seja "Suite" e depois encontra dentro desse card o botão "Book now". CSS puro não é confiável aqui porque seletores como :has()/:contains() não são suportados de forma consistente no Selenium; XPath é a opção mais direta.

Exemplo de XPath (exato e robusto):
//div[contains(@class,'card') and .//h5[contains(@class,'card-title') and normalize-space(.)='Suite']]//a[contains(@class,'btn') and normalize-space(.)='Book now']

Código C# pronto para sua Page Object (usa WebDriverWait e clica com segurança):

public void ClickBookNowForRoom(string roomName, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    var xpath = $"//div[contains(@class,'card') and .//h5[contains(@class,'card-title') and normalize-space(.)='{roomName}']]//a[contains(@class,'btn') and normalize-space(.)='Book now']";
    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));
    var el = wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            var e = d.FindElement(By.XPath(xpath));
            return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    });

using Bogus;

public static class ContactFactory
{
    private static readonly Faker Faker = new Faker();

    public static Contact CreateRandomContact()
    {
        return new Contact
        {
            FirstName = Faker.Name.FirstName(),
            LastName = Faker.Name.LastName(),
            Email = Faker.Internet.Email(),
            Phone = Faker.Phone.PhoneNumber("##########") // 10-digit, adjust mask as needed
        };
    }
}

public class Contact
{
    public string FirstName { get; init; } = "";
    public string LastName  { get; init; } = "";
    public string Email     { get; init; } = "";
    public string Phone     { get; init; } = "";
}
HomePage: método FillContactFormAndReturnData

// inside HomePage class (uses _wait and _driver fields)
public Contact FillContactFormAndReturnData(int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    var contact = ContactFactory.CreateRandomContact();

    var firstSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-firstname[name='firstname'], input.form-control.room-firstname[name='firstname']");
    var lastSel  = By.CssSelector("input.room-lastname[name='lastname'], input.form-control.room-lastname[name='lastname']");
    var emailSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-email[name='email'], input.form-control.room-email[name='email']");
    var phoneSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-phone[name='phone'], input.form-control.room-phone[name='phone']");

    var wait = new OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI.WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

    // helper to find and fill
    IWebElement FindAndClearSend(By by, string value)
    {
        var el = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(by);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        el.Clear();
        el.SendKeys(value);
        return el;
    }

    FindAndClearSend(firstSel, contact.FirstName);
    FindAndClearSend(lastSel, contact.LastName);
    FindAndClearSend(emailSel, contact.Email);
    FindAndClearSend(phoneSel, contact.Phone);

    return contact;
}

o codigo está retornando esse erro quando tenta clicar nesse botão

Esse erro significa que o elemento está presente no DOM mas não pôde ser clicado porque algo o interceptou (por exemplo: elemento sobreposto, sticky footer, animação, ou o elemento está fora da viewport). Soluções comuns e um método robusto que você pode colar no seu Page Object:

Estratégias usadas
Scroll para o elemento (centro da viewport) para evitar overlays.
Esperar até o elemento estar clicável (visível + enabled).
Tentar clicar com Actions ou JavaScript se Click normal falhar.
Fazer retries e capturar screenshot em falha.
Código pronto (C# — cole no seu HomePage)
csharp

Collapse


 Copy

public void ClickReserveNow(int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    var by = By.CssSelector("button#doReservation");
    var wait = new OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI.WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

    try
    {
        // wait element exists + visible
        var el = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(by);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });

        if (el == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Reserve Now button not found or not visible.");

        // scroll element into center of viewport to avoid sticky overlays
        ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block: 'center'});", el);
        System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(200); // short pause for layout

        try
        {
            // try normal click
            el.Click();
            return;
        }
        catch (OpenQA.Selenium.ElementClickInterceptedException)
        {
            // fallback: try Actions move+click
            try
            {
                var actions = new OpenQA.Selenium.Interactions.Actions(_driver);
                actions.MoveToElement(el).Click().Perform();
                return;
            }
            catch
            {
                // final fallback: JS click
                ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("arguments[0].click();", el);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        // diagnostic: screenshot + rethrow
        try
        {
            var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_driver).GetScreenshot();
            var file = $"click_reserve_failed_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.png";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(file, ss.AsByteArray);
            Console.WriteLine($"ClickReserveNow failed: {ex.Message}. Screenshot: {file}. URL: {_driver.Url}");
        }
        catch { /* ignore */ }

        throw;
    }
}
Outras dicas
Verifique se há banners/overlays (cookies, notifications) — feche-os antes de clicar. Você pode adicionar um helper que tenta fechar elementos comuns, ex.: selector ".cookie-banner .close".
Aumente o timeout se a página faz carregamentos trasnacionais.
Ao usar headless, elementos às vezes têm layout diferente; teste também com headful (headless = false) quando depurar.
Evite Thread.Sleep em produção; usado aqui apenas curto para estabilizar após scroll — substitua por wait por condição se preferir.

adapto o método para retornar bool em vez de lançar, com mensagens mais amigáveis. Deseja isso?

                    return;

                catch

        var el = d.FindElement(OpenQA.Selenium.By.XPath("//h2[normalize-space() = 'Booking Confirmed']"));
        return (el.Displayed) ? el : null;
    }
    catch { return null; }
});

// Assert

// Assert the confirmation paragraph text exists and starts with the expected sentence
var confirmationParagraph = _fix.Driver.FindElement(OpenQA.Selenium.By.XPath("//h2[normalize-space() = 'Booking Confirmed']/following-sibling::p"));
confirmationParagraph.Text.Should().Contain("Your booking has been confirmed for the following dates:");

// Optionally assert displayed dates are present (strong element)
var strongEl = _fix.Driver.FindElements(OpenQA.Selenium.By.XPath("//h2[normalize-space() = 'Booking Confirmed']/following-sibling::p//strong"))
                 .FirstOrDefault();
strongEl.Should().NotBeNull();
strongEl.Text.Should().MatchRegex(@"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}"); // simple date pattern check
}

Notes:

Replace room.ClickDoReservation() with the actual method name you implemented to submit the reservation (e.g., ClickDoReservation or SubmitBooking).
If booking dates are selected earlier in the flow, ensure the test sets them before submission. If the confirmation shows specific checkin/checkout you generated, you can assert exact strings instead of regex.
The XPath used locates the h2 "Booking Confirmed" and the following p; adjust if DOM differs.
The test uses WebDriverWait to avoid flakiness.
Add using directives if not present: using OpenQA.Selenium; using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI; using System; using System.Linq;
If you want, I can adapt the test to assert exact dates (if you generate them in the test) or add screenshot-on-failure.

eu quero um metodo que insere o valor de data validos para checkin e checkout

Use este método na sua Page Object (RoomPage) para preencher campos de checkin/checkout com datas válidas. Ele:

aceita DateTime (ou gera hoje+1 / hoje+3 se não passar),
formata as datas no padrão dd/MM/yyyy (ajuste se sua app usar outro formato),
encontra os inputs (por name, classe ou um seletor seguro),
define o valor via JavaScript (mais robusto contra datepickers customizados) e dispara eventos de input/change,
faz espera e captura screenshot em caso de falha,
retorna as strings usadas (útil para asserções).
Cole no RoomPage:

public (string checkin, string checkout) SetBookingDates(DateTime? checkin = null, DateTime? checkout = null, int timeoutSeconds = 5)
{
    // default: tomorrow -> +2 nights
    var ci = checkin ?? DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(1);
    var co = checkout ?? ci.AddDays(2);

text

Collapse


 Copy

// format as displayed in the page (example: "16/02/2026")
string fmt = "dd/MM/yyyy";
var ciStr = ci.ToString(fmt);
var coStr = co.ToString(fmt);

// selectors for the inputs — adjust if your inputs have name/id attributes
var checkinBy = By.CssSelector("input[name='checkin'], input.form-control[placeholder='Check In'], .react-datepicker__input-container input");
var checkoutBy = By.CssSelector("input[name='checkout'], input.form-control[placeholder='Check Out'], .react-datepicker__input-container input");

var wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

try
{
    // find inputs (choose first matching pair: checkin -> first, checkout -> second)
    var inputs = wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            var els = d.FindElements(By.CssSelector(".react-datepicker__input-container input, input.form-control"));
            return (els != null && els.Count >= 2) ? els : null;
        }
        catch { return null; }
    });

    var checkinEl = inputs[0];
    var checkoutEl = inputs[1];

    // set value via JS and dispatch input/change events (works with custom datepickers)
    var js = (IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver;
    js.ExecuteScript("arguments[0].value = arguments[1]; arguments[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); arguments[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));", checkinEl, ciStr);
    js.ExecuteScript("arguments[0].value = arguments[1]; arguments[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); arguments[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));", checkoutEl, coStr);

    // small wait to let any UI update
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(200);

    // optionally verify values applied
    var appliedCi = checkinEl.GetAttribute("value") ?? checkinEl.GetAttribute("value");
    var appliedCo = checkoutEl.GetAttribute("value") ?? checkoutEl.GetAttribute("value");

    return (appliedCi, appliedCo);
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    try
    {
        var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_driver).GetScreenshot();
        var file = $"set_dates_failed_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.png";
        System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(file, ss.AsByteArray);
        Console.WriteLine($"SetBookingDates failed: {ex.Message}. Screenshot: {file}. URL: {_driver.Url}");
    }
    catch { /* ignore */ }
    throw;
}
}

// 1) Preenche com dados fornecidos (não gera aleatório)
public void FillContactForm(Contact contact, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    if (contact is null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(contact));

    var firstSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-firstname[name='firstname'], input.form-control.room-firstname[name='firstname']");
    var lastSel  = By.CssSelector("input.room-lastname[name='lastname'], input.form-control.room-lastname[name='lastname']");
    var emailSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-email[name='email'], input.form-control.room-email[name='email']");
    var phoneSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-phone[name='phone'], input.form-control.room-phone[name='phone']");

    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

    IWebElement FindAndClearSend(By by, string value)
    {
        var el = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try { var e = d.FindElement(by); return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null; }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        el.Clear();
        el.SendKeys(value ?? string.Empty);
        return el;
    }

    FindAndClearSend(firstSel, contact.FirstName);
    FindAndClearSend(lastSel, contact.LastName);
    FindAndClearSend(emailSel, contact.Email);
    FindAndClearSend(phoneSel, contact.Phone);
}

// 2) Captura mensagens de validação visíveis (inline/alerts) e mensagens nativas do input
public IReadOnlyCollection<string> GetVisibleValidationMessages(int timeoutSeconds = 3)
{
    var msgs = new List<string>();
    try
    {
        // common selectors for inline/server errors
        var selectors = new[] { ".invalid-feedback", ".text-danger", ".form-error", ".alert-danger" };
        foreach (var sel in selectors)
        {
            var elements = _driver.FindElements(By.CssSelector(sel));
            foreach (var e in elements)
                if (e.Displayed && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(e.Text))
                    msgs.Add(e.Text.Trim());
        }

        // fallback: HTML5 validationMessage for inputs
        var inputSelectors = new[]
        {
            "input.room-firstname[name='firstname'], input.form-control.room-firstname[name='firstname']",
            "input.room-lastname[name='lastname'], input.form-control.room-lastname[name='lastname']",
            "input.room-phone[name='phone'], input.form-control.room-phone[name='phone']",
            "input.room-email[name='email'], input.form-control.room-email[name='email']"
        };

        foreach (var sel in inputSelectors)
        {
            try
            {
                var el = _driver.FindElement(By.CssSelector(sel));
                var validation = ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("return arguments[0].validationMessage;", el) as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validation)) msgs.Add(validation.Trim());
            }
            catch { /* ignore missing input */ }
        }
    }
    catch { /* ignore */ }

    return msgs.Distinct().ToList().AsReadOnly();
}
Como usar nos testes data‑driven

Para cada caso crie um Contact com valores inválidos e chame:
room.FillContactForm(contact);
room.ClickDoReservation() (ou Submit);
var errors = room.GetVisibleValidationMessages();
errors.Should().NotBeEmpty(); // ou verificar mensagens específicas
Resumo

Não altere FillContactFormAndReturnData() (mantê‑la é útil para fluxos que precisam de dados gerados).
Adicione FillContactForm(Contact) para testes dirigidos e GetVisibleValidationMessages() para assert de erros.

// Fill the contact form with the provided Contact object.
// Uses explicit waits and clears each field before typing.
public void FillContactForm(Contact contact, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    if (contact is null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(contact));

    // CSS selectors for the inputs (adjust if your DOM differs)
    var firstSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-firstname[name='firstname'], input.form-control.room-firstname[name='firstname']");
    var lastSel  = By.CssSelector("input.room-lastname[name='lastname'], input.form-control.room-lastname[name='lastname']");
    var emailSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-email[name='email'], input.form-control.room-email[name='email']");
    var phoneSel = By.CssSelector("input.room-phone[name='phone'], input.form-control.room-phone[name='phone']");

    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

    // Helper: wait for element, clear it, and send value
    IWebElement FindAndClearSend(By by, string value)
    {
        var el = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(by);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        });
        el.Clear();
        el.SendKeys(value ?? string.Empty);
        return el;
    }

    // Fill fields
    FindAndClearSend(firstSel, contact.FirstName);
    FindAndClearSend(lastSel, contact.LastName);
    FindAndClearSend(emailSel, contact.Email);
    FindAndClearSend(phoneSel, contact.Phone);
}

// Collect visible validation/error messages on the page.
// Returns distinct, visible messages from common alert/inline selectors
// and falls back to HTML5 input.validationMessage for inputs.
public IReadOnlyCollection<string> GetVisibleValidationMessages(int timeoutSeconds = 3)
{
    var msgs = new List<string>();

    try
    {
        // Common selectors for inline or server-side error messages
        var selectors = new[] { ".invalid-feedback", ".text-danger", ".form-error", ".alert-danger" };

        foreach (var sel in selectors)
        {
            var elements = _driver.FindElements(By.CssSelector(sel));
            foreach (var e in elements)
            {
                if (e.Displayed && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(e.Text))
                    msgs.Add(e.Text.Trim());
            }
        }

        // Fallback: check HTML5 validation messages on inputs (browser native)
        var inputSelectors = new[]
        {
            "input.room-firstname[name='firstname'], input.form-control.room-firstname[name='firstname']",
            "input.room-lastname[name='lastname'], input.form-control.room-lastname[name='lastname']",
            "input.room-phone[name='phone'], input.form-control.room-phone[name='phone']",
            "input.room-email[name='email'], input.form-control.room-email[name='email']"
        };

        foreach (var sel in inputSelectors)
        {
            try
            {
                var el = _driver.FindElement(By.CssSelector(sel));
                var validation = ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("return arguments[0].validationMessage;", el) as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validation))
                    msgs.Add(validation.Trim());
            }
            catch
            {
                // ignore missing inputs
            }
        }
    }
    catch
    {
        // swallow exceptions here — caller will handle empty result as "no visible messages"
    }

    return msgs.Distinct().ToList().AsReadOnly();
}

os meus testes nao estao fazendo o teardown como eu implemento isso nos meus testes?

Use explicit cleanup that runs after each test and reliably removes any created resources. Two safe patterns work well with xUnit:

A — Per-test try/finally (simple, explicit)

Save created IDs in local vars and delete them in finally so cleanup always runs even if assertions fail.
Example (async):

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

[Fact]
public async Task MyTest()
{
    int? bookingId = null;
    int? roomId = null;

    try
    {
        // ARRANGE / ACT
        var room = RoomFactory.Create();
        var token = await new AutomationTestingAuthClient().GetTokenAsync("admin","password");
        var roomClient = new RoomClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase));
        var createRoomResp = await roomClient.CreateRoomAsync(room, token);
        // parse roomId from response...
        roomId = /* extracted id */;

        var booking = CreateRandomBooking();
        booking.roomid = roomId!.Value;
        var bookingClient = new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase));
        var createBookingResp = await bookingClient.CreateBookingAsync(booking);
        bookingId = /* extracted booking id */;

        // ASSERTs...
    }
    finally
    {
        // Best-effort cleanup (do not throw)
        try { if (bookingId.HasValue) await new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase)).DeleteBookingAsync(bookingId.Value, token); } catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine($"Cleanup booking failed: {ex.Message}"); }
        try { if (roomId.HasValue) await new RoomClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase)).DeleteRoomAsync(roomId.Value, token); } catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine($"Cleanup room failed: {ex.Message}"); }
    }
}
B — Shared cleanup in the test class using IAsyncLifetime (neater for many tests)

Collect created IDs in a concurrent-safe list and delete them in DisposeAsync.
Example:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

public class MyUiOrApiTests : IAsyncLifetime
{
    private readonly List<int> _roomsToDelete = new();
    private readonly List<int> _bookingsToDelete = new();

    public Task InitializeAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;

    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        var roomClient = new RoomClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase));
        var bookingClient = new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase));
        var token = await new AutomationTestingAuthClient().GetTokenAsync("admin","password");
        // delete bookings first
        foreach (var id in _bookingsToDelete)
        {
            try { await bookingClient.DeleteBookingAsync(id, token); } catch { }
        }
        foreach (var id in _roomsToDelete)
        {
            try { await roomClient.DeleteRoomAsync(id, token); } catch { }
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task TestThatCreatesResources()
    {
        // create room/booking...
        int roomId = /* ... */;
        _roomsToDelete.Add(roomId);
        int bookingId = /* ... */;
        _bookingsToDelete.Add(bookingId);
    }
}
Practical tips

Use best-effort cleanup (catch exceptions and log) — cleanup should not hide original test failures.
Delete bookings before rooms (foreign-key / logical dependencies).
Use same auth token used to create resources (or admin token) when deleting.
Prefer API deletion (fast, reliable) over UI flows for teardown.
For parallel tests, ensure unique data (RoomFactory/BookingFactory) so cleanup targets correct resources.
Consider timeouts/retries for deletes if backend is eventually consistent.
Which pattern do you want me to generate in your repository — per-test finally examples or a IAsyncLifetime-based test base with automatic tracking?

teardown da execução

Use a centralized "teardown after run" approach that reliably removes created resources (bookings, rooms) when tests finish. Preferred pattern for your test suite:

Track created resource IDs during tests (thread-safe).
Perform best-effort deletion in an async teardown step (IAsyncLifetime.DisposeAsync) or a shared fixture Dispose/DisposeAsync.
Delete bookings before rooms.
Log failures but do not mask original test failures.
Example implementation (paste into your test project):

Cleanup tracker fixture (register this as a collection or use IClassFixture across tests)

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

public class TestResourceTracker : IAsyncDisposable
{
    internal ConcurrentBag<int> Bookings { get; } = new();
    internal ConcurrentBag<int> Rooms { get; } = new();

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        // nothing here if you prefer explicit DisposeAsync call later
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }
}
Global cleanup helper (performs deletion using admin token)
csharp

Collapse


 Copy

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

public static class TestResourceCleanup
{
    public static async Task CleanupAsync(TestResourceTracker tracker)
    {
        if (tracker is null) return;

        // get admin token once
        var auth = new AutomationTestingAuthClient();
        string token;
        try { token = await auth.GetTokenAsync("admin", "password"); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine($"Failed to obtain admin token for cleanup: {ex.Message}"); return; }

        var bookingClient = new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase));
        var roomClient = new RoomClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase));

        // Delete bookings first (best-effort; swallow exceptions)
        foreach (var id in tracker.Bookings)
        {
            try
            {
                var resp = await bookingClient.DeleteBookingAsync(id, token);
                Console.WriteLine($"Cleanup: deleted booking {id} -> {(int)resp.StatusCode}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Cleanup: failed to delete booking {id}: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        // Then delete rooms
        foreach (var id in tracker.Rooms)
        {
            try
            {
                var resp = await roomClient.DeleteRoomAsync(id, token);
                Console.WriteLine($"Cleanup: deleted room {id} -> {(int)resp.StatusCode}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Cleanup: failed to delete room {id}: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }
}
Use in tests (per-test recording, then global teardown)

Run cleanup after suite
If you want teardown after all tests in a run, create a dedicated cleanup test last (not ideal), or better register an [AssemblyFixture] or use CI job step to call cleanup.
Simpler: implement a test-class-level IAsyncLifetime to call TestResourceCleanup.CleanupAsync(Tracker) in DisposeAsync.
Example IAsyncLifetime in a base test class:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

public abstract class ResourceTrackingTestBase : IAsyncLifetime
{
    protected TestResourceTracker Tracker { get; } = new();

    public Task InitializeAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;

    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        await TestResourceCleanup.CleanupAsync(Tracker);
    }
}
Then inherit your tests from ResourceTrackingTestBase.

Notes and best practices

Use ConcurrentBag to support parallel tests (still possible race conditions — prefer test isolation).
Keep cleanup best-effort: catch/log exceptions and continue.
Delete bookings before rooms to avoid foreign-key/booking constraints.
If tests run in parallel across processes/agents, implement a central cleanup job (CI) or tag created resources with a unique run id and clean by query via admin endpoints.
Prefer explicit per-test finally cleanup when tests must guarantee immediate removal.

Short answer: you don't call Driver.Quit() manually at the end of each test if you're using a fixture that disposes the driver. Let the fixture handle it. But if you need the driver closed per-test, use a per-test fixture (or implement IDisposable/IAsyncLifetime on the test class) so Quit/Dispose runs automatically.

Options and examples:

Per-class (recommended with IClassFixture)
Keep WebDriverFixture implementing IDisposable. Use IClassFixture in the test class. xUnit will construct the fixture once for the class and call Dispose() on it after the class finishes (so the driver quits automatically).
No manual call required in tests.
public class HomePageTests : IClassFixture
{
    private readonly WebDriverFixture _fix;
    public HomePageTests(WebDriverFixture fix) => _fix = fix;
    // tests...
}
// WebDriverFixture.Dispose() will be called by xUnit when the test class finishes.

Per-test (if you want driver closed after every test)
Make the test class itself implement IDisposable (or IAsyncLifetime). Create driver in constructor (or use a factory) and quit in Dispose — xUnit constructs a new test class instance per test, so Dispose is called after each test.
public class HomePageTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
    public HomePageTests()
    {
        _driver = WebDriverFactory.Create(new WebDriverOptions { Headless = true });
    }

Manual finally (least preferred)
If you deliberately create driver in a test method, call Quit in finally block:
IWebDriver driver = WebDriverFactory.Create(...);
try
{
    // test steps
}
finally
{
    try { driver.Quit(); } catch { }
    try { driver.Dispose(); } catch { }
}

Notes / best practice

Prefer fixture patterns (IClassFixture for class-level, IDisposable on test class for per-test) — xUnit will call Dispose automatically.
Avoid calling Driver.Quit() from tests directly; centralize cleanup in the fixture to ensure consistent behavior and screenshot/logging on failures.
Ensure you call Quit then Dispose (Quit closes browser process; Dispose disposes driver object).
If tests run in parallel, create one driver per test (per-test fixture) to avoid interference.

ElementClickInterceptedException means something (overlay, sticky element, off‑screen) blocks the click. Replace your simple click with a robust routine: scroll into view, wait for clickable, try normal click → Actions → JS, and capture screenshot on failure. Paste this implementation into your Page Object (replace existing ClickBookNowForRoom):

public void ClickBookNowForRoom(string roomName, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    // XPath locates the card with the title text and its "Book now" link
    var xpath = $"//div[contains(@class,'card') and .//h5[contains(@class,'card-title') and normalize-space(.)='{roomName}']]//a[contains(@class,'btn') and normalize-space(.)='Book now']";
    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

text

Collapse


 Copy

try
{
    var el = wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            var e = d.FindElement(By.XPath(xpath));
            return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    });

    if (el == null)
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Book now button for room '{roomName}' not found.");

    // Scroll element into center of viewport to avoid overlays
    ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block: 'center'});", el);
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(150); // short pause to allow layout

    try
    {
        // normal click attempt
        el.Click();
        return;
    }
    catch (OpenQA.Selenium.ElementClickInterceptedException)
    {
        // fallback: action move + click
        try
        {
            var actions = new OpenQA.Selenium.Interactions.Actions(_driver);
            actions.MoveToElement(el).Click().Perform();
            return;
        }
        catch
        {
            // final fallback: JS click
            ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("arguments[0].click();", el);
            return;
        }
    }
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    // diagnostic: screenshot + rethrow to surface failure
    try
    {
        var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_driver).GetScreenshot();
        var file = $"click_booknow_failed_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.png";
        System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(file, ss.AsByteArray);
        Console.WriteLine($"ClickBookNowForRoom failed: {ex.Message}. Screenshot saved to {file}. URL: {_driver.Url}");
    }
    catch { /* ignore screenshot errors */ }

    throw;
}
}

Use this same pattern for other clickable elements (Reserve/Submit) to reduce flakiness.

tem dois testes que quero automatizar, mas o sistema tem um comportamento indevido, os testes são fazer um booking para um quarto que já tem booking para a data selecionada e o teste de colocar uma data de checkin superior de checkout. 

o resultado dos dois casos é o seguinte: resposta do booking - 409 Conflict
{"error":"Failed to create booking"}
e a unica coisa que aparece na tela é o seguinte:Application error: a client-side exception has occurred while loading automationintesting.online (see the browser console for more information).

qual é a melhor abordagem nesse caso?

This is a client/server failure mismatch — the API returns a correct 409 (conflict) but the SPA crashes client‑side and shows a generic “Application error” page. For testing you should treat API and UI behaviors separately and capture artifacts for triage. Recommended approach:

Assert API behavior first (definitive)
In your API test assert status == 409 and body contains {"error":"Failed to create booking"}. This verifies the backend rejects the invalid request reliably.
Keep these tests in the API suite (fast, deterministic).
For the UI test, treat the SPA crash as a bug, gather evidence and fail the test
In the UI flow after submitting the booking:
Wait for API response (if you submit via JS you may call the API directly or observe network response).
If API returns 409 → capture:
Browser screenshot (already in your POM).
Browser console logs (JS errors).
Network HAR or at least request/response bodies.
Assert the SPA did not show a graceful validation message; instead assert that an application error page is shown (or that a client error occurred). Fail test and attach artifacts.
Implement capture helpers (if not already)
Screenshot on failure (you have).
Collect console logs: ((OpenQA.Selenium.ILog)driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(LogType.Browser)) and save.
Save network HAR (via browser devtools protocol or proxy) if possible.
Save the API response body.
Test expectations
For API-level tests: expect 409 + body.
For UI-level tests: expect either:
Graceful client validation (preferred): page shows user-friendly message and no app crash — assert presence of that message, or
If SPA crashes (current behavior): treat as bug -> capture artifacts and fail test (so team sees regression). Do not silently accept SPA crash as “expected”.
Example UI test flow (pseudocode)
Arrange: create room and existing booking for dates via API.
Act: open UI, navigate to room, fill dates (same), submit.
Observe API/network: if request returns 409, assert API behavior.
Assert UI: either find validation error on page OR detect app crash.
If crash: take screenshot, collect console logs, save network, fail the test with message and attach artifacts.
Create a bug report (mandatory) when SPA crashes Include:
Steps to reproduce (exact UI clicks + payload),
API request/response (409 + body),
Browser console error text + stack trace,
Screenshot(s) and network HAR,
Test name and environment (URL, driver, time). Label as High/Blocker for UI.
Short-term mitigation in automation
Prefer API assertions for validation rules (cover those in API test suite).
Mark UI E2E test as failing/skipped until frontend bug is fixed, but keep it reporting (so it creates tickets).
Add retry logic or check that SPA recovers after refresh if that’s acceptable.
Long-term fixes to ask the devs
SPA should handle 4xx/409 gracefully (show message without crashing).
If client-side parsing of API response causes exception, fix patch to handle unexpected error payload.
If you want, I can:

Provide a code snippet for the UI test that captures console logs + screenshot + network HAR on 409 and then fails with a helpful message, or
Generate an issue template (pre-filled) that your automation can open with artifacts.
Which would you prefer?

[Fact(DisplayName = "UI-XX - Booking with checkin > checkout shows failure and captures artifacts on crash")]
public void Booking_CheckinAfterCheckout_ShowsFailedToCreateBooking_OrCaptureArtifacts()
{
    // Arrange
    var home = new HomePage(_fix.Driver, "https://automationintesting.online");
    var room = new RoomPage(_fix.Driver, "https://automationintesting.online");

    home.GoTo();
    home.IsLoaded().Should().BeTrue();

    // Open booking UI for 'Suite' card (adjust room name as needed)
    home.ClickBookNowForRoom("Suite");

    // Act / Prepare invalid dates: checkin after checkout
    var checkin = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(10);
    var checkout = checkin.AddDays(-2); // invalid: checkout before checkin
    // Use RoomPage method to set the dates; returns applied values
    var (appliedCheckin, appliedCheckout) = room.SetBookingDates(checkin, checkout);

    // Fill contact with (valid) random data
    var contact = room.FillContactFormAndReturnData(); // generates and fills random contact

    // Submit reservation (adjust method name if different)
    room.ClickDoReservation(); // or room.ClickReserveNowForBooking()

    // Assert - look for expected error message on UI
    try
    {
        var wait = new OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI.WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(6));

        // Wait for either explicit inline error or application error text
        var errorEl = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                // common error containers
                var candidate = d.FindElements(OpenQA.Selenium.By.CssSelector(".alert-danger, .text-danger, .form-error, .invalid-feedback"))
                                 .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed && e.Text.Trim().Length > 0);
                if (candidate != null) return candidate;

                // application error page headline
                var appErr = d.FindElements(OpenQA.Selenium.By.XPath("//*[contains(text(),'Application error') or contains(text(),'Failed to create booking')]"))
                              .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                if (appErr != null) return appErr;

                return null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });

        // If we have an element, assert it contains the expected message
        errorEl.Should().NotBeNull(because: "the UI should show an error message when booking fails");
        var msg = errorEl.Text.Trim();
        msg.Should().Contain("Failed to create booking", because: "the backend returns 409 with error and UI should reflect it");
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        // On failure, capture artifacts for bug triage (screenshot + console logs) and fail with details.
        try
        {
            // Screenshot
            var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_fix.Driver).GetScreenshot();
            var screenshotFile = $"booking_invalid_dates_failed_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.png";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(screenshotFile, ss.AsByteArray);

            // Console logs (browser)
            var consoleLogs = new List<string>();
            try
            {
                var logEntries = _fix.Driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(OpenQA.Selenium.LogType.Browser);
                foreach (var entry in logEntries) consoleLogs.Add($"{entry.Timestamp} {entry.Level} {entry.Message}");
            }
            catch (Exception) { consoleLogs.Add("Could not collect browser console logs (not supported)."); }

            // Page source / current URL
            var currentUrl = _fix.Driver.Url;
            var pageSourceFile = $"booking_invalid_dates_page_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.html";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText(pageSourceFile, _fix.Driver.PageSource);

            // Compose failure message
            var details = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            details.AppendLine("Booking test failed to find expected error on UI.");
            details.AppendLine($"Exception: {ex.Message}");
            details.AppendLine($"URL: {currentUrl}");
            details.AppendLine($"Screenshot: {screenshotFile}");
            details.AppendLine($"Page source saved to: {pageSourceFile}");
            details.AppendLine("Console logs:");
            details.AppendLine(string.Join(Environment.NewLine, consoleLogs));

            // Optionally write to test output (if you have ITestOutputHelper available)
            try { _output?.WriteLine(details.ToString()); } catch { /* ignore */ }

            // Fail the test with the composed message
            throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException(details.ToString());
        }
        catch (Exception finalEx)
        {

That message means the test project can't see the AutomationTestingAuthClient type. Fix options (pick one) — do the first if you already placed the client in Arancia.Test.API.Clients.

Add the correct using and make sure the class is public
At the top of your test file add: using Arancia.Test.API.Clients;
Ensure AutomationTestingAuthClient is declared public: namespace Arancia.Test.API.Clients { public class AutomationTestingAuthClient : IAuthClient { ... } }
If the class lives in another project (API.Tests), add a project reference
From UI.Tests project folder: dotnet add reference ../API.Tests/API.Tests.csproj
Then rebuild. This lets UI.Tests use types from API.Tests.
If you prefer to keep UI tests independent, implement a tiny local auth helper in UI.Tests
Minimal inline code to get token (no project reference needed):

// top: using RestSharp; using System.Text.Json;
async Task GetAutomationTokenLocalAsync(string user = "admin", string pass = "password")
{
var client = new RestClient("https://automationintesting.online/api");
var req = new RestRequest("auth/login", Method.Post)
    .AddHeader("Accept","application/json")
    .AddJsonBody(new { username = user, password = pass });
var resp = await client.ExecuteAsync(req);
if (resp.StatusCode != System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK) throw new Exception("Auth failed: " + resp.Content);
using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(resp.Content!);
return doc.RootElement.GetProperty("token").GetString()!;
}

Use this instead of AutomationTestingAuthClient.GetTokenAsync in your UI tests.

Verify build and visibility
Ensure UI.Tests project references the assembly containing the client and both projects target compatible frameworks.
Run: dotnet clean && dotnet build

qual é a melhor forma de realizar isso?

Both approaches are valid — pick based on maintainability and coupling you want.

Options

Reuse existing client (recommended if you already maintain API clients centrally)
Pros: single implementation, no duplicate code, easier to keep behavior consistent.
Cons: couples UI.Tests to API.Tests project.
How:
Add a project reference from UI.Tests to the project containing AutomationTestingAuthClient: dotnet add src/UI.Tests/UI.Tests.csproj reference src/API.Tests/API.Tests.csproj
Add the proper using at the top of your test: using Arancia.Test.API.Clients;
Rebuild: dotnet build
Add a tiny local auth helper in UI.Tests (recommended if you want UI tests independent / faster)
Pros: keeps UI project self-contained, minimal code, no cross-project overhead.
Cons: duplicates small code; keep it tiny and stable.
Minimal helper (copy into your test class or a small helper file in UI.Tests):
async Task GetAutomationTokenLocalAsync(string user = "admin", string pass = "password")
{
    var client = new RestSharp.RestClient("https://automationintesting.online/api");
    var req = new RestSharp.RestRequest("auth/login", RestSharp.Method.Post)
        .AddHeader("Accept", "application/json")
        .AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
        .AddJsonBody(new { username = user, password = pass });
    var resp = await client.ExecuteAsync(req);
    if (resp.StatusCode != System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Auth failed. Status: {(int)resp.StatusCode}. Body: {resp.Content}");
    using var doc = System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(resp.Content!);
    return doc.RootElement.GetProperty("token").GetString()!;
}

Use it in your UI test instead of AutomationTestingAuthClient.

Which to choose

If you plan to run many integration/UI tests and already maintain API client code, add the project reference (Option 1).
If you prefer UI tests isolated or want fastest turnaround, add the small local helper (Option 2).
Tell me which you prefer and I’ll give the exact code/commands to apply.

Argumento 2: não é possível converter de "System.StringComparison" para "string"

That error means you tried to call string.Contains with a StringComparison argument but your project targets a runtime where that overload isn’t available. Use IndexOf with a StringComparison instead.

Replace code like this (invalid in some targets):
errEl.Text.Contains("Failed to create booking", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

With this (portable and correct):
errEl.Text.IndexOf("Failed to create booking", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0

Or if you prefer a helper:
private static bool TextContains(string source, string term) =>
    source?.IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;

Then use:
TextContains(errEl.Text, "Failed to create booking")

Make that change wherever you passed StringComparison into Contains. Rebuild and the error will disappear.

a parte do codigo que está dando erro é a seguinte:

Replace that assertion with a case-insensitive check using IndexOf (Contains overload with StringComparison isn't available). Example:

// old (causes error)
// errEl.Text.Should().Contain("Failed to create booking", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

// new (works on all targets)
errEl.Text.IndexOf("Failed to create booking", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    .Should().BeGreaterOrEqualTo(0, "expected error message to contain 'Failed to create booking' (case-insensitive)");

Or define a small helper:

private static bool ContainsIgnoreCase(string src, string term) =>
    src?.IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;

and assert:

ContainsIgnoreCase(errEl.Text, "Failed to create booking").Should().BeTrue();

‘NumericAssertions<int>’ não contém uma definição para "BeGreaterOrEqualTo" e não foi possível encontrar nenhum método de extensão "BeGreaterOrEqualTo" que aceite um primeiro argumento do tipo ‘NumericAssertions<int>’ (você está se esquecendo de usar uma diretiva ou uma referência de assembly?)

Use the alternative assertion method BeGreaterThanOrEqualTo (which is available) instead of BeGreaterOrEqualTo. Replace:

errEl.Text.IndexOf("Failed to create booking", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    .Should().BeGreaterOrEqualTo(0, "expected error message...");

with:

errEl.Text.IndexOf("Failed to create booking", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    .Should().BeGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0, "expected error message to contain 'Failed to create booking' (case-insensitive)");

The failure is because your lookup is searching for the wrong room name. You check for "Single" but you assert that "Suite" must exist — so roomId stays -1. Fix: search for the intended room name (and use a case‑insensitive compare and log the available room names if not found).

Replace this block:

text

Collapse


 Copy

int roomId = -1;
foreach (var r in roomsEl.EnumerateArray())
{
    if (r.TryGetProperty("roomName", out var rn) && rn.GetString() == "Single" &&
        r.TryGetProperty("roomid", out var rid) && rid.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number)
    {
        roomId = rid.GetInt32();
        break;
    }
}
roomId.Should().BeGreaterThan(0, "Suite room must exist in rooms list");
With the corrected code below (case‑insensitive, logs available room names for diagnostics):

text

Collapse


 Copy

// look for the Suite room
var targetRoomName = "Suite";
int roomId = -1;
var availableNames = new List<string>();
foreach (var r in roomsEl.EnumerateArray())
{
    if (r.TryGetProperty("roomName", out var rn))
    {
        var name = rn.GetString() ?? string.Empty;
        availableNames.Add(name);
        if (string.Equals(name.Trim(), targetRoomName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            && r.TryGetProperty("roomid", out var rid) && rid.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number)
        {
            roomId = rid.GetInt32();
            break;
        }
    }
}

// helpful diagnostic if not found
if (roomId <= 0)
{
    _output.WriteLine($"Available room names: {string.Join(", ", availableNames)}");
}

roomId.Should().BeGreaterThan(0, $"{targetRoomName} room must exist in rooms list");
After that change the rest of the test will use the correct roomId (your rooms JSON shows Suite has roomid 3). Also consider trimming and case-insensitive comparisons everywhere you match texts from the API/UI to avoid brittle failures.

 Copy

{"roomid":3,"roomName":"103","type":"Suite", ...}
So your code is searching for roomName == "Suite" and will never find it, leaving roomId = -1. You should search by type == "Suite" (or by roomName == "103" if that’s what you intend).

        r.TryGetProperty("roomid", out var rid) && rid.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number)

var available = new List<(string RoomName, string Type)>();

foreach (var r in roomsEl.EnumerateArray())
{
    var roomNameVal = r.TryGetProperty("roomName", out var rnEl) ? rnEl.GetString() ?? "" : "";

    available.Add((roomNameVal, typeVal));

        r.TryGetProperty("roomid", out var rid) && rid.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number)
    {
        roomId = rid.GetInt32();
        break;
    }
}

if (roomId <= 0)
{
    _output.WriteLine("Available rooms from API:");
    foreach (var (rn, t) in available)
        _output.WriteLine($"roomName={rn}, type={t}");
}

roomId.Should().BeGreaterThan(0, "Suite room must exist in rooms list");
Now roomId will be set to 3 (the record where type == "Suite"), and the assertion will pass if that room exists.

After this change, the rest of the test (pre‑creating the booking via API and then attempting the UI booking to get 409/“Failed to create booking”) should behave as intended.

preciso de um metodo que insere admin no username, password em password e clica em Login

Here’s a reusable method you can add to a Page Object (e.g., AdminLoginPage or even HomePage if you map the admin login there) that:

Navigates to the admin login URL (optional),
Enters admin in username and password in password,
Clicks the “Login” button using a safe wait.
Adjust selectors and URL as needed.

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;
using System;

public class AdminLoginPage
{
    private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
    private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
    private readonly string _baseUrl;

    // adjust these selectors to match your DOM
    private readonly By _usernameInput = By.CssSelector("input[name='username'], input#username");
    private readonly By _passwordInput = By.CssSelector("input[name='password'], input#password");
    private readonly By _loginButton  = By.CssSelector("button[type='submit'], button.btn-primary");

    public AdminLoginPage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
    {
        _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
        _baseUrl = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/');
        _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
    }

    public void GoToLogin()
    {
        // adjust path if your admin login is at a different URL
        _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl($"{_baseUrl}/#/admin");
    }

    public void LoginAsAdmin()
    {
        // optional: navigate to login page first
        GoToLogin();

        // wait & fill username
        var userEl = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(_usernameInput);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        userEl.Clear();
        userEl.SendKeys("admin");

        // wait & fill password
        var passEl = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(_passwordInput);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        passEl.Clear();
        passEl.SendKeys("password");

        // click Login
        var btn = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(_loginButton);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        btn.Click();
    }
}

Collapse
