using System;
using System.Linq;
using FluentAssertions;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;
using UI.Tests.Fixture;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

public class AdminLoginTests : IClassFixture<WebDriverFixture>
{
    private readonly WebDriverFixture _fix;
    private readonly ITestOutputHelper _output;
    private readonly AdminLoginPage _login;

    public AdminLoginTests(WebDriverFixture fix, ITestOutputHelper output)
    {
        _fix = fix ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(fix));
        _output = output ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(output));
        _login = new AdminLoginPage(_fix.Driver, "https://automationintesting.online");
    }

    [Fact(DisplayName = "UI-11 - Admin login with valid credentials")]
    public void AdminLogin_WithValidCredentials_ShowsAdminDashboard()
    {
        // Arrange
        _login.GoToLogin();

        // Act
        _login.LoginAsAdmin(); // uses admin / password

        // Assert
        var wait = new WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

        // Wait until either Rooms and Report menus are visible,
        // or we hit timeout (which will throw)
        IWebElement roomsMenu = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var el = d.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Rooms']"))
                          .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                return el;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });

        IWebElement reportMenu = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var el = d.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Report']"))
                          .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                return el;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });

        roomsMenu.Should().NotBeNull("Rooms menu should be visible after successful admin login");
        reportMenu.Should().NotBeNull("Report menu should be visible after successful admin login");
    }

    [Fact(DisplayName = "UI-12 - Admin login with invalid credentials shows error")]
    public void AdminLogin_WithInvalidCredentials_ShowsErrorAndStaysOnLogin()
    {
        // Arrange
        _login.GoToLogin();

        // Act
        // Use generic login method; if you don't have it, add Login(string,string) as shown above
        _login.Login("wronguser", "wrongpass");

        // Assert
        var wait = new WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8));

        // 1) Error message "Invalid credentials" should be visible
        IWebElement? errorEl = null;
        try
        {
            errorEl = wait.Until(d =>
            {
                try
                {
                    // try common error selectors + text match
                    var el = d.FindElements(By.XPath("//*[contains(text(),'Invalid credentials')]"))
                              .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                    if (el != null) return el;

                    var alerts = d.FindElements(By.CssSelector(".alert-danger, .text-danger, .form-error"));
                    return alerts.FirstOrDefault(e =>
                        e.Displayed &&
                        e.Text.IndexOf("Invalid credentials", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
                }
                catch { return null; }
            });
        }
        catch (WebDriverTimeoutException)
        {
            // leave errorEl as null
        }

        errorEl.Should().NotBeNull("Invalid credentials error message should be shown for wrong admin login");

        // 2) Still on login page: username field should still be present
        IWebElement? userInput = null;
        try
        {
            userInput = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.CssSelector("input[name='username'], input#username"))
                                   .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
        }
        catch { }

        userInput.Should().NotBeNull("User should remain on login page after invalid credentials");

        // 3) Optional: ensure admin menus are NOT visible
        var roomsMenus = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Rooms']"));
        roomsMenus.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse("Rooms menu should not be visible after invalid login");

        var reportMenus = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Report']"));
        reportMenus.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse("Report menu should not be visible after invalid login");
    }
}
Pontos a ajustar conforme seu DOM real:

Se o admin login está em outra rota (por exemplo /#/admin), ajuste GoToLogin() na POM para essa URL.
Se o texto do erro for diferente de "Invalid credentials", ajuste o XPath/Contains.
Se os menus “Rooms”/“Report” forem outro tipo de elemento (por exemplo <li><a>Rooms</a></li>), mantenha o XPath //a[normalize-space()='Rooms']; se forem botões, altere para //button[normalize-space()='Rooms'].
Se quiser, posso também gerar uma pequena classe AdminLoginPage completa com os seletores que você me mostrar do HTML da tela de login (para garantir que os seletores batem exatamente com o DOM).

Aqui está um teste de logout seguindo o mesmo padrão das suas classes atuais (IClassFixture, uso de AdminLoginPage, asserts simples) e validando acesso negado à URL protegida após logout.

Pré‑requisitos:

AdminLoginPage já tem LoginAsAdmin() e GoToLogin().
Após login, existe um botão Logout com: <button class="btn btn-outline-danger my-2 my-sm-0">Logout</button>.
A URL protegida é https://automationintesting.online/admin/rooms.
Na página de login admin existe o input de username input[name='username'] (ou id #username).
Adicione este teste em uma classe de teste de admin (por exemplo, AdminLoginTests) onde você já injeta WebDriverFixture e ITestOutputHelper:

Collapse


 Copy

[Fact(DisplayName = "UI-13 - Logout invalidates admin session")]
public void AdminLogout_InvalidatesSession_AndBlocksProtectedUrl()
{
    // Arrange
    var baseUrl = "https://automationintesting.online";
    var loginPage = new AdminLoginPage(_fix.Driver, baseUrl);
    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

    // 1) Login as admin
    loginPage.GoToLogin();
    loginPage.LoginAsAdmin();

    // 2) Ensure we are on admin area (Rooms menu visible)
    var roomsMenu = wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            return d.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Rooms']"))
                    .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
        }
        catch { return null; }
    });
    roomsMenu.Should().NotBeNull("Rooms menu should be visible after admin login");

    // 3) Click logout button
    var logoutButton = wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            return d.FindElements(By.CssSelector("button.btn.btn-outline-danger"))
                    .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed && e.Text.Trim().Equals("Logout", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }
        catch { return null; }
    });
    logoutButton.Should().NotBeNull("Logout button should be visible in admin nav");
    logoutButton!.Click();

    // Act - try to access a protected URL after logout
    var protectedUrl = $"{baseUrl}/admin/rooms";
    _fix.Driver.Navigate().GoToUrl(protectedUrl);

    // Assert
    // 1) We should be on login page again (username field visible)
    IWebElement? usernameInput = null;
    try
    {
        usernameInput = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var el = d.FindElements(By.CssSelector("input[name='username'], input#username"))
                          .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                return el;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
    }
    catch (WebDriverTimeoutException)
    {
        // ignore here, assertion below will fail with better message
    }

    usernameInput.Should().NotBeNull("After logout, accessing a protected URL should redirect to the admin login page");

    // 2) Admin menus (e.g., Rooms) should not be visible anymore
    var roomsMenus = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Rooms']"));
    roomsMenus.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse("Rooms menu should not be visible after logout");

    var reportMenus = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Report']"));
    reportMenus.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse("Report menu should not be visible after logout");
}
Notas:

Ajuste o seletor do botão Logout se necessário (por exemplo, se a classe mudar ou se houver mais de um botão com esse CSS).
Se a URL de login admin não for /#/admin, ajuste o método GoToLogin() na sua AdminLoginPage.
Se, em vez de redirect, o app mostrar uma página de erro quando acessa /admin/rooms após logout, você pode adaptar o assert para procurar por elementos da tela de erro ou pela ausência de conteúdo admin.
Se quiser, posso também extrair o clique no botão Logout para um método Logout() dentro de uma POM de AdminDashboardPage, para manter o teste ainda mais limpo.

using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;
using System;
using System.Linq;

public class AdminAuthPage
{
    private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
    private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
    private readonly string _baseUrl;

    // adjust these selectors to your DOM
    private readonly By _usernameInput = By.CssSelector("input[name='username'], input#username");
    private readonly By _passwordInput = By.CssSelector("input[name='password'], input#password");
    private readonly By _loginButton  = By.CssSelector("button[type='submit'], button.btn-primary");
    private readonly By _logoutButton = By.CssSelector("button.btn.btn-outline-danger");

    public AdminAuthPage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
    {
        _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
        _baseUrl = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/');
        _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
    }

    public void GoToLogin()
    {
        // adjust path if needed
        _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl($"{_baseUrl}/admin");
    }

    public void LoginAsAdmin()
    {
        Login("admin", "password");
    }

    public void Login(string username, string password)
    {
        GoToLogin();

        var userEl = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(_usernameInput);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        userEl.Clear();
        userEl.SendKeys(username);

        var passEl = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(_passwordInput);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        passEl.Clear();
        passEl.SendKeys(password);

        var btn = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElement(_loginButton);
                return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
        btn.Click();
    }

    public void Logout()
    {
        // waits until the logout button is visible and clicks it
        var btn = _wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var candidates = d.FindElements(_logoutButton);
                return candidates.FirstOrDefault(e =>
                    e.Displayed &&
                    e.Text.Trim().Equals("Logout", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });

        if (btn == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Logout button not found on admin page.");

        btn.Click();
    }
}
Ajuste o caminho de GoToLogin() se seu login admin estiver em outra rota (por exemplo /#/admin).

voce pode me explicar esse teste?
### UI-14 — Input validation and escaping in UI

| Field           | Description                                                                                               |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ID             | UI-14                                                                                                     |
| Title          | UI handles special characters / scripts safely in user input                                             |
| Precondition   | Homepage or relevant input forms available.                                                              |
| Steps          | 1. Enter `<script>alert(1)</script>` and other special chars into text fields. <br> 2. Submit booking/form. |
| Expected       | Data displayed as plain text; no script executed; no UI breakage.                                        |
| Severity       | High                                                                                                      |

---

Esse teste garante que a aplicação trata entradas “maliciosas” como texto normal, sem executar código e sem quebrar o layout — ou seja, é um teste de escaping / proteção contra XSS e injeções simples na UI.

Vamos quebrar o cenário:

Objetivo do UI-14
Verificar se a UI:

Não executa scripts inseridos em campos de texto (por exemplo <script>alert(1)</script>).
Não quebra o layout quando recebe caracteres especiais (HTML, JavaScript, etc.).
Exibe esses dados como texto literal (“”) se/onde forem reapresentados.
Em outras palavras: o teste confirma que os inputs do usuário são tratados com escaping adequado e não geram XSS / erros de JavaScript.

Pré-condição
A homepage ou um formulário relevante (como o formulário de booking ou contato) está acessível.
Você sabe quais campos de texto serão usados (por exemplo: firstname, lastname, descrição, mensagem).
Passos (detalhados)
Abrir a página com o formulário  

Ex.: https://automationintesting.online.
Garantir que a página carregou corretamente (IsLoaded()).
Inserir strings “perigosas” em campos de texto
Exemplos:

<script>alert(1)</script>
"><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
"Robert'); DROP TABLE Users;-- (SQL-like)
Você pode usar essas strings em:
firstname
lastname
description
message / comments
Submeter o formulário / booking  

Clicar no botão de submit / reservar / enviar.
Esperar a resposta normal da UI (p.ex. mensagem de sucesso, linha de booking criada, etc.).
Observar o que acontece na UI  

Verificar se a página continua funcionando (sem tela de erro, sem layout quebrado).
Ver se os valores aparecem em algum lugar da tela (como texto puro):
Ex.: em uma listagem de bookings, tabela, resumo, card etc.
O que deve ser verificado (Expected)
Nenhum script executado

Não deve aparecer nenhum alert inesperado.
Nenhuma execução de JavaScript vindo daquele texto.
Na prática, em teste automático você valida:
Que não ocorreu erro de JS grave (console logs, página de “Application error”).
Que o HTML gerado contém o texto escapado (ex: &lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt; ou literal dentro de um nó de texto, não dentro de <script>).
Dados exibidos como texto simples

Se o firstname for <script>alert(1)</script>, você deve vê-lo na tela como essa string (ou uma versão escapada), não como um script rodando.
Em Selenium: localizar o elemento que mostra o valor e conferir que o .Text contém a string original (ou que os caracteres < > foram convertidos, mas sem romper o DOM).
Nenhuma quebra de UI

A página ainda renderiza normalmente.
Nenhum componente “sumiu” ou ficou desconfigurado por causa do input.
Como isso se traduz em código de teste (conceitualmente)
Em uma automação típica:

Arrange

Abrir HomePage.
Navegar até o formulário de booking ou contato.
Act

Preencher os campos de texto com <script>alert(1)</script>.
Submeter o formulário.
Assert

Verificar que:
Status visual da página é o esperado (sem tela de erro).
O valor é exibido como texto (por exemplo: GetText() do elemento onde a informação aparece).
Opcionalmente verificar console logs para garantir que não houve exceção crítica de JS.
Por que esse teste é importante?
Evita vulnerabilidades de XSS (Cross-Site Scripting), onde um usuário malicioso poderia injetar código JavaScript que roda no browser de outros usuários (roubando cookies, tokens, etc.).
Garante que mecanismos de sanitização/escaping estão ativos na camada de UI e/ou backend.
É um teste funcional + de segurança básica, classificado como High porque uma falha aqui é um problema sério de segurança.
Se quiser, posso:

Escrever um teste UI concreto em C# com Selenium usando seus POMs (HomePage, RoomPage) que implementa esse cenário (AAA, asserts, captura de screenshot se quebrar), ou
Ajudar a definir quais campos/formulários específicos da sua aplicação devem ser usados para esse teste (booking vs. contact form).
vamos criar esse metodo de teste?

Segue um método de teste completo para o cenário UI‑14, usando o mesmo padrão de HomePageTests (com _home, _room, _fix, _output já existentes) e os métodos que você já tem na POM (ClickBookNowForRoom, ClickReserveNow, FillContactForm(Contact), ClickReserveNowForBooking).

Ele:

Preenche o formulário com strings “maliciosas” (<script>alert(1)</script> etc.),
Submete a reserva,
Verifica que aparece o “Booking Confirmed” (ou seja, não quebrou a UI),
Garante que não aparece “Application error”,
Verifica que a string maliciosa aparece no HTML como texto (não redirecionou para erro genérico).

[Fact(DisplayName = "UI-14 - UI handles injection-like input as plain text (no script execution)")]
public void BookingForm_InjectionLikeInput_TreatedAsPlainText()
{
    // Arrange
    _home.GoTo();
    _home.IsLoaded().Should().BeTrue();

    // Open booking UI for a specific room card
    _home.ClickBookNowForRoom("Suite");
    _room.ClickReserveNow();

    // Malicious-like strings
    var scriptPayload = "<script>alert(1)</script>";
    var imgPayload = "\"><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>";

    // Build contact with injection-like strings
    var contact = new Contact
    {
        FirstName = scriptPayload,
        LastName = imgPayload,
        Email = "xss-tester@example.com",
        Phone = "12345678901" // valid length, we don't want validation error here
    };

    // Act – fill form and submit
    _room.FillContactForm(contact);
    _room.ClickReserveNowForBooking(); // submit booking

    // Assert – UI should not break and should treat data as plain text
    try
    {
        var wait = new OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI.WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

        // 1) Booking Confirmed card should appear (no application crash)
        var heading = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                return d.FindElements(By.XPath("//h2[normalize-space()='Booking Confirmed']"))
                        .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });

        heading.Should().NotBeNull("Booking Confirmed heading should appear after successful booking, even with special characters in input");

        // 2) Page should NOT show generic application error
        var appError = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//*[contains(text(),'Application error')]"))
                                  .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
        appError.Should().BeNull("UI should not crash with 'Application error' on injection-like input");

        // 3) The payload should be present in the page source as text (no script execution)
        var pageSource = _fix.Driver.PageSource;
        pageSource.Should().Contain(scriptPayload, "the raw script-like payload should be stored/displayed as text, not executed");
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        // On any unexpected behavior, capture artifacts for triage
        var ts = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

        try
        {
            var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_fix.Driver).GetScreenshot();
            var screenshotFile = $"booking_xss_{ts}.png";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(screenshotFile, ss.AsByteArray);
            _output.WriteLine($"Saved screenshot: {screenshotFile}");
        }
        catch (Exception se) { _output.WriteLine($"Screenshot failed: {se.Message}"); }

        try
        {
            var pageFile = $"booking_xss_{ts}.html";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText(pageFile, _fix.Driver.PageSource);
            _output.WriteLine($"Saved page source: {pageFile}");
        }
        catch (Exception pe) { _output.WriteLine($"Save page source failed: {pe.Message}"); }

        try
        {
            var logs = new List<string>();
            var entries = _fix.Driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(LogType.Browser);
            logs.AddRange(entries.Select(e => $"{e.Timestamp} {e.Level} {e.Message}"));
            var logFile = $"booking_xss_console_{ts}.log";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllLines(logFile, logs);
            _output.WriteLine($"Saved console logs: {logFile}");
        }
        catch (Exception le) { _output.WriteLine($"Collect console logs failed: {le.Message}"); }

        throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException($"UI did not handle injection-like input as expected. See artifacts. Exception: {ex.Message}");
    }
}

        }
        catch (Exception le) { _output.WriteLine($"Collect console logs failed ({caseId}): {le.Message}"); }

        throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException(

    }

[Fact(DisplayName = "UI-xx - Admin can create a new room from /admin/rooms")]
public void AdminCanCreateNewRoom_FromAdminRoomsPage()
{
    var baseUrl = "https://automationintesting.online";
    var admin = new AdminAuthPage(_fix.Driver, baseUrl);
    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

    // ARRANGE
    // 1) Login as admin (should land on /admin/rooms)
    admin.GoToLogin();
    admin.LoginAsAdmin();

    // Ensure we are on /admin/rooms (or navigate explicitly)
    _fix.Driver.Url.Should().Contain("/admin/rooms");

    // Generate random room number and price between 100 and 250
    var rnd = new Random();
    var roomNumber = rnd.Next(100, 251).ToString(); // inclusive 100-250
    var roomPrice  = rnd.Next(100, 251).ToString();

    // Locators based on your screenshot/HTML (ajuste se necessário)
    var roomNameInput  = By.CssSelector("input[name='roomName']");
    var roomPriceInput = By.CssSelector("input[name='roomPrice']");
    var typeSelect     = By.CssSelector("select[name='type']");
    var accessibleSelect = By.CssSelector("select[name='accessible']");

    // feature checkboxes (WiFi, TV, Radio, Refreshments, Safe)
    var wifiCheckbox  = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='WiFi'], input#wifi");
    var tvCheckbox    = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='TV'], input#tv");
    var radioCheckbox = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Radio'], input#radio");
    var refCheckbox   = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Refreshments'], input#refreshments");
    var safeCheckbox  = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Safe'], input#safe");

    var createButton = By.XPath("//button[normalize-space()='Create']");

    // ACTIONS para preencher e criar
    // 2) Preencher room# e price
    IWebElement Find(By by) => wait.Until(d =>
    {
        try
        {
            var e = d.FindElement(by);
            return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
        }
        catch { return null; }
    });

    var roomNameEl = Find(roomNameInput);
    roomNameEl.Clear();
    roomNameEl.SendKeys(roomNumber);

    var roomPriceEl = Find(roomPriceInput);
    roomPriceEl.Clear();
    roomPriceEl.SendKeys(roomPrice);

    // 3) Selecionar primeira opção de Type e Accessible
    var typeEl = Find(typeSelect);
    var typeSel = new SelectElement(typeEl);
    typeSel.SelectByIndex(0); // primeira opção

    var accEl = Find(accessibleSelect);
    var accSel = new SelectElement(accEl);
    accSel.SelectByIndex(0); // primeira opção

    // 4) Selecionar APENAS WiFi
    void SetCheckbox(By by, bool shouldBeChecked)
    {
        try
        {
            var el = _fix.Driver.FindElement(by);
            if (el.Selected != shouldBeChecked)
            {
                el.Click();
            }
        }
        catch { /* ignore if not present */ }
    }

    SetCheckbox(wifiCheckbox,  true);
    SetCheckbox(tvCheckbox,    false);
    SetCheckbox(radioCheckbox, false);
    SetCheckbox(refCheckbox,   false);
    SetCheckbox(safeCheckbox,  false);

    // 5) Clicar em Create
    var createEl = Find(createButton);
    createEl.Click();

    // ASSERT
    // Esperar até que uma nova linha contendo o roomNumber e o preço apareça.
    // Pelas colunas do screenshot: Room #, Type, Accessible, Price, Room details
    // Vamos procurar por uma <tr> onde a primeira coluna = roomNumber e a 4ª coluna = roomPrice
    var rowXpath = $"//table//tr[td[1][normalize-space()='{roomNumber}'] and td[4][normalize-space()='{roomPrice}']]";

    IWebElement? newRow = null;
    try
    {
        newRow = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var e = d.FindElements(By.XPath(rowXpath)).FirstOrDefault(r => r.Displayed);
                return e;
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
    }
    catch (WebDriverTimeoutException)
    {
        // vai falhar nas asserts abaixo com mensagem melhor
    }

    newRow.Should().NotBeNull($"A new row with room number {roomNumber} and price {roomPrice} should be present after creation");

    // Opcionalmente validar detalhes (Type, Accessible, Room details contem "WiFi")
    var cells = newRow!.FindElements(By.XPath("./td")).ToList();
    cells.Count.Should().BeGreaterOrEqualTo(5, "Expected at least 5 columns in rooms table");

    var typeText       = cells[1].Text.Trim();
    var accessibleText = cells[2].Text.Trim();
    var priceText      = cells[3].Text.Trim();
    var detailsText    = cells[4].Text.Trim();

    priceText.Should().Be(roomPrice);
    detailsText.Should().Contain("WiFi", "Room details should list WiFi as selected feature");
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;

namespace UI.Tests.Pages
{
    public class AdminRoomsPage
    {
        private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
        private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
        private readonly string _baseUrl;

        // Locators – ajuste se o DOM for diferente
        private readonly By _roomNameInput   = By.CssSelector("input[name='roomName']");
        private readonly By _roomPriceInput  = By.CssSelector("input[name='roomPrice']");
        private readonly By _typeSelect      = By.CssSelector("select[name='type']");
        private readonly By _accessibleSelect = By.CssSelector("select[name='accessible']");

        private readonly By _wifiCheckbox    = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='WiFi'], input#wifi");
        private readonly By _tvCheckbox      = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='TV'], input#tv");
        private readonly By _radioCheckbox   = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Radio'], input#radio");
        private readonly By _refCheckbox     = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Refreshments'], input#refreshments");
        private readonly By _safeCheckbox    = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Safe'], input#safe");

        private readonly By _createButton    = By.XPath("//button[normalize-space()='Create']");

        public AdminRoomsPage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
        {
            _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
            _baseUrl = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/');
            _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        }

        public void GoTo()
        {
            _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl($"{_baseUrl}/admin/rooms");
        }

        // Helper to find visible & enabled element
        private IWebElement Find(By by) =>
            _wait.Until(d =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var e = d.FindElement(by);
                    return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
                }
                catch { return null; }
            });

        private void SetCheckbox(By by, bool shouldBeChecked)
        {
            try
            {
                var el = _driver.FindElement(by);
                if (el.Selected != shouldBeChecked)
                    el.Click();
            }
            catch
            {
                // ignore missing checkbox in this POM
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a room with given roomNumber & price, selecting only WiFi in room details,
        /// and selecting first options for Type and Accessible.
        /// </summary>
        public void CreateRoom(int roomNumber, int price)
        {
            // fill room#
            var roomNameEl = Find(_roomNameInput);
            roomNameEl.Clear();
            roomNameEl.SendKeys(roomNumber.ToString());

            // fill price
            var roomPriceEl = Find(_roomPriceInput);
            roomPriceEl.Clear();
            roomPriceEl.SendKeys(price.ToString());

            // select first option for Type
            var typeEl = Find(_typeSelect);
            var typeSel = new SelectElement(typeEl);
            typeSel.SelectByIndex(0);

            // select first option for Accessible
            var accEl = Find(_accessibleSelect);
            var accSel = new SelectElement(accEl);
            accSel.SelectByIndex(0);

            // room details: only WiFi
            SetCheckbox(_wifiCheckbox,  true);
            SetCheckbox(_tvCheckbox,    false);
            SetCheckbox(_radioCheckbox, false);
            SetCheckbox(_refCheckbox,   false);
            SetCheckbox(_safeCheckbox,  false);

            // click Create
            var createEl = Find(_createButton);
            createEl.Click();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Waits until a table row with this roomName and roomPrice appears in the rooms table.
        /// Returns the row element or null if not found within timeout.
        /// </summary>
        public IWebElement? WaitForRoomRow(int roomNumber, int price, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
        {
            var rowXpath = $"//table//tr[td[1][normalize-space()='{roomNumber}'] and td[4][normalize-space()='{price}']]";
            var localWait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

            try
            {
                return localWait.Until(d =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        return d.FindElements(By.XPath(rowXpath))
                                .FirstOrDefault(r => r.Displayed);
                    }
                    catch { return null; }
                });
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    {

        _adminAuth.GoToLogin();

        // Assert (UI) – row added on screen

        row.Should().NotBeNull($"a new row with room #{roomNumber} and price {roomPrice} should be visible in the rooms table");

        // Optional: check that Room details contains "WiFi"
        var cells = row!.FindElements(By.XPath("./td")).ToList();
        cells.Count.Should().BeGreaterOrEqualTo(5);

        // Assert (API) – new room appears in GET /room

        adminToken.Should().NotBeNullOrWhiteSpace();

        var apiRoomClient = new RoomClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(apiBase));

        _output.WriteLine($"GET /room status: {(int)roomsResp.StatusCode} - {roomsResp.StatusCode}");
        _output.WriteLine($"Body: {roomsResp.Content}");

        roomsResp.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        roomsResp.Content.Should().NotBeNullOrWhiteSpace();

        using var roomsDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(roomsResp.Content!);

        var foundInApi = roomsEl.EnumerateArray().Any(r =>
        {
            try
            {
                var rn = r.GetProperty("roomName").GetString();
                var price = r.GetProperty("roomPrice").GetInt32();
                return rn == roomNumber.ToString() && price == roomPrice;
            }
            catch
            {
                return false;
            }
        });

    }

using System;
using System.Linq;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;

namespace UI.Tests.Pages
{
    public class AdminRoomsPage
    {
        private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
        private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
        private readonly string _baseUrl;

        // Adjust selectors based on your actual DOM
        private readonly By _pageAnchor      = By.XPath("//h2[normalize-space()='Rooms']"); // or any unique element on /admin/rooms
        private readonly By _roomNameInput   = By.CssSelector("input[name='roomName'], input[placeholder='Room #']");
        private readonly By _roomPriceInput  = By.CssSelector("input[name='roomPrice'], input[placeholder='Price']");
        private readonly By _typeSelect      = By.CssSelector("select[name='type']");
        private readonly By _accessibleSelect = By.CssSelector("select[name='accessible']");

        private readonly By _wifiCheckbox    = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='WiFi'], input#wifi");
        private readonly By _tvCheckbox      = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='TV'], input#tv");
        private readonly By _radioCheckbox   = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Radio'], input#radio");
        private readonly By _refCheckbox     = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Refreshments'], input#refreshments");
        private readonly By _safeCheckbox    = By.CssSelector("input[type='checkbox'][value='Safe'], input#safe");

        private readonly By _createButton    = By.XPath("//button[normalize-space()='Create']");

        public AdminRoomsPage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
        {
            _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
            _baseUrl = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/');
            _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        }

        public void GoTo()
        {
            _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl($"{_baseUrl}/admin/rooms");
            // wait anchor element of /admin/rooms
            _wait.Until(d =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var el = d.FindElements(_pageAnchor).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                    return el != null;
                }
                catch { return false; }
            });
        }

        // Helper to find visible & enabled element
        private IWebElement Find(By by) =>
            _wait.Until(d =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var e = d.FindElement(by);
                    return (e.Displayed && e.Enabled) ? e : null;
                }
                catch { return null; }
            });

        private void SetCheckbox(By by, bool shouldBeChecked)
        {
            try
            {
                var el = _driver.FindElement(by);
                if (el.Selected != shouldBeChecked)
                    el.Click();
            }
            catch
            {
                // ignore missing checkbox in this POM
            }
        }

        public void CreateRoom(int roomNumber, int price)
        {
            // fill room#
            var roomNameEl = Find(_roomNameInput);
            roomNameEl.Clear();
            roomNameEl.SendKeys(roomNumber.ToString());

            // fill price
            var roomPriceEl = Find(_roomPriceInput);
            roomPriceEl.Clear();
            roomPriceEl.SendKeys(price.ToString());

            // select first option for Type
            var typeEl = Find(_typeSelect);
            var typeSel = new SelectElement(typeEl);
            typeSel.SelectByIndex(0);

            // select first option for Accessible
            var accEl = Find(_accessibleSelect);
            var accSel = new SelectElement(accEl);
            accSel.SelectByIndex(0);

            // room details: only WiFi
            SetCheckbox(_wifiCheckbox,  true);
            SetCheckbox(_tvCheckbox,    false);
            SetCheckbox(_radioCheckbox, false);
            SetCheckbox(_refCheckbox,   false);
            SetCheckbox(_safeCheckbox,  false);

            // click Create
            var createEl = Find(_createButton);
            createEl.Click();
        }

        public IWebElement? WaitForRoomRow(int roomNumber, int price, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
        {
            var rowXpath = $"//table//tr[td[1][normalize-space()='{roomNumber}'] and td[4][normalize-space()='{price}']]";
            var localWait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

            try
            {
                return localWait.Until(d =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        return d.FindElements(By.XPath(rowXpath))
                                .FirstOrDefault(r => r.Displayed);
                    }
                    catch { return null; }
                });
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}

O mais seguro é procurar o container .row.room que tenha:

Abaixo está uma versão atualizada de WaitForRoomRow que usa essa estrutura (em vez de <table>/<tr>/<td>). Cole esse método na sua AdminRoomsPage no lugar do antigo:

public IWebElement? WaitForRoomRow(int roomNumber, int price, int timeoutSeconds = 10)
{
    // XPath: find a DIV with classes 'row' and 'room' that contains
    // a child element with the roomNumber text and a <p> with id 'roomPrice*' and the price text.
    var rowXpath =
        $"//div[contains(@class,'row') and contains(@class,'room')]" +
        $"[.//*[normalize-space()='{roomNumber}'] and .//p[starts-with(@id,'roomPrice') and normalize-space()='{price}']]";

    var localWait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

    try
    {
        return localWait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                var rows = d.FindElements(By.XPath(rowXpath));
                return rows.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Displayed);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        });
    }
    catch
    {
        return null;
    }
}

                return rows.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Displayed);

}

### UI-20 — Unauthorized actions from UI

| Field           | Description                                                                  |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ID             | UI-20                                                                        |
| Title          | Prevent destructive actions from unauthenticated user                        |
| Precondition   | Not logged in.                                                               |
| Steps          | 1. Try to access admin/edit/delete URLs directly from address bar or UI.    |
| Expected       | Redirect to login / access denied; no create/update/delete executed.        |
| Severity       | High                                                                         |

---

Abaixo está um teste UI implementando o cenário UI‑20, usando o mesmo padrão das suas classes atuais (fixture WebDriverFixture, POM AdminAuthPage e AdminRoomsPage). Ele garante:

Que o usuário não está logado (ou seja, acessa diretamente a URL protegida).
Ao tentar abrir /admin/rooms, é redirecionado para a tela de login admin.
Não há menus nem ações de Rooms/Report disponíveis (nenhuma ação destrutiva é exposta).
Se você já tem AdminAuthPage e AdminRoomsPage como nas respostas anteriores, só precisa colar o teste abaixo.

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

[Fact(DisplayName = "UI-20 - Unauthorized actions from UI are blocked")]
public void UnauthorizedUser_CannotAccessAdminRoomsOrPerformDestructiveActions()
{
    var baseUrl = "https://automationintesting.online";
    var protectedUrl = $"{baseUrl}/admin/rooms";
    var wait = new WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

    // ARRANGE – ensure we start from a "not logged in" state
    // Acesso direto à URL protegida sem fazer login antes
    _fix.Driver.Manage().Cookies.DeleteAllCookies();
    _fix.Driver.Navigate().GoToUrl(protectedUrl);

    // ACT – tentar acessar /admin/rooms sem autenticação

    // ASSERT 1: deve cair na tela de login admin (campo username visível)
    IWebElement? usernameInput = null;
    try
    {
        usernameInput = wait.Until(d =>
        {
            try
            {
                return d.FindElements(By.CssSelector("input[name='username'], input#username"))
                        .FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
            }
            catch { return null; }
        });
    }
    catch (WebDriverTimeoutException)
    {
        // continuará sendo verificado abaixo
    }

    usernameInput.Should().NotBeNull(
        "Accessing a protected admin URL while not logged in should redirect to the admin login page");

    // ASSERT 2: menus/admin controls não devem estar visíveis
    var roomsMenus = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Rooms']"));
    roomsMenus.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse("Rooms menu should not be visible for unauthenticated users");

    var reportMenus = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.XPath("//a[normalize-space()='Report']"));
    reportMenus.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse("Report menu should not be visible for unauthenticated users");

    // ASSERT 3 (opcional): nenhuma action de delete deve estar visível na tela
    var deleteIcons = _fix.Driver.FindElements(By.CssSelector(".roomDelete, .fa-remove"));
    deleteIcons.Any(e => e.Displayed).Should().BeFalse(
        "Delete icons should not be visible or usable without admin authentication");

    // Se quiser ser ainda mais explícito, você pode tentar forçar um DELETE via UI
    // (por ex., clicando em um link direto, caso exista) e garantir que a aplicação
    // redireciona de volta para login ou retorna uma mensagem de acesso negado.
}
Pontos que você pode ajustar conforme o DOM:

input[name='username'], input#username.
Se os menus admin forem outros textos (ex.: “Rooms” / “Report”), mantenha o XPath ou adapte.
Se não existir .roomDelete / .fa-remove no DOM antes de login, o teste já garante que não há ações destrutivas disponíveis.
Se quiser, posso também adicionar uma variação que:

Primeiro cria um room e/ou booking via API,
Depois tenta acessar diretamente uma URL de edição/deleção (por exemplo /admin/rooms/{id} ou trigger via query string),
E valida tanto a resposta HTTP quanto a UI (login/erro 401).

o var baseUrl = "https://automationintesting.online"; está sendo usado por mais de um metodo de teste, como eu posso utilizar colocando em apenas um lugar?

You have a few good options; the simplest is to centralize the base URL in one constant/field or a small settings class and reuse it everywhere.

Option A — Class-level readonly field (per test class)
If only this test class needs the URL, declare it once at the top of the class:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

public class AdminAuthTests : IClassFixture<WebDriverFixture>
{
    private readonly WebDriverFixture _fix;
    private readonly ITestOutputHelper _output;
    private readonly string _baseUrl = "https://automationintesting.online";

    private readonly AdminAuthPage _adminAuth;
    private readonly AdminRoomsPage _adminRooms;

    public AdminAuthTests(WebDriverFixture fix, ITestOutputHelper output)
    {
        _fix = fix ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(fix));
        _output = output ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(output));

        _adminAuth = new AdminAuthPage(_fix.Driver, _baseUrl);
        _adminRooms = new AdminRoomsPage(_fix.Driver, _baseUrl);
    }

    [Fact(DisplayName = "UI-20 - Unauthorized actions from UI are blocked")]
    public void UnauthorizedUser_CannotAccessAdminRoomsOrPerformDestructiveActions()
    {
        var protectedUrl = $"{_baseUrl}/admin/rooms";
        var wait = new WebDriverWait(_fix.Driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

        _fix.Driver.Manage().Cookies.DeleteAllCookies();
        _fix.Driver.Navigate().GoToUrl(protectedUrl);

        // ... rest of the test ...
    }
}
Now you reuse _baseUrl in all test methods and POM instantiations in that class.

Option B — Shared UI Settings class (for all UI tests)
If multiple test classes need the same base URL, create a small settings class in UI.Tests:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

// UI.Tests/Settings.cs (or UI.Tests/Helpers/UiSettings.cs)
namespace UI.Tests
{
    public static class UiSettings
    {
        public static string BaseUrl =>
            Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("UI_BASE_URL")
            ?? "https://automationintesting.online";
    }
}
Then in tests and POMs:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

using UI.Tests;

// in constructor
_adminAuth = new AdminAuthPage(_fix.Driver, UiSettings.BaseUrl);
_adminRooms = new AdminRoomsPage(_fix.Driver, UiSettings.BaseUrl);

// in tests
var protectedUrl = $"{UiSettings.BaseUrl}/admin/rooms";
This is nice for CI too, because you can override UI_BASE_URL per environment.

Option C — Store in WebDriverFixture (per test run)
If every UI test uses the same base URL, you can keep it in the fixture:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

public class WebDriverFixture : IDisposable
{
    public IWebDriver Driver { get; }
    public string BaseUrl { get; } =
        Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("UI_BASE_URL")
        ?? "https://automationintesting.online";

    public WebDriverFixture()
    {
        var options = new WebDriverOptions { /* ... */ };
        Driver = WebDriverFactory.Create(options);
    }

    // Dispose...
}
Then in your tests:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

public HomePageTests(WebDriverFixture fix, ITestOutputHelper output)
{
    _fix = fix;
    _home = new HomePage(_fix.Driver, _fix.BaseUrl);
    _room = new RoomPage(_fix.Driver, _fix.BaseUrl);
    _output = output;
}

// in tests
var protectedUrl = $"{_fix.BaseUrl}/admin/rooms";
Recommendation

If you only need it in a couple of classes: use Option A (readonly field) or Option C (in fixture).
If many UI tests share it and you want environment-variable support: use Option B or C.
Given your current structure (already using WebDriverFixture and multiple POMs), Option C (BaseUrl in WebDriverFixture) is usually the cleanest.

### UI-21 — Create booking via API and verify in UI

| Field           | Description                                                   |
|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|

quero desenvolver esse teste de integração.
Então vamos criar um booking via API utilizando o nosso projeto Arancia.Test.API e validar no frontend. Para isso vamos ter que logar como admin usando nosso POM AdminAuthPage e acessar a pagina Report(html do botão no menu- <li class="nav-item"><a id="reportLink" class="nav-link active" href="/admin/report">Report</a></li>). Então acho que vamos precisar de uma POM para a pagina report tambem. E validar se aparece na tela, lembrando que o html para os bookings nessa tela fica dessa forma aqui:
<div class="rbc-event rbc-event-allday"><div class="rbc-event-content" title="James Dean - Room: 101">James Dean - Room: 101</div></div>

You can implement this integration test cleanly with a small POM for the Admin Report page plus a test that:

Creates a booking via API (Arancia.Test.API),
Logs in as admin through the UI,
Navigates to /admin/report,
Asserts the booking appears as an event like Firstname Lastname - Room: 101.
Below are the two parts:

1) POM: AdminReportPage
Create UI.Tests/Pages/AdminReportPage.cs:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

using System;
using System.Linq;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;

namespace UI.Tests.Pages
{
    public class AdminReportPage
    {
        private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
        private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
        private readonly string _baseUrl;

        // Booking event entries on the calendar
        private static readonly By _bookingEventContent = By.CssSelector(".rbc-event-content");

        public AdminReportPage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
        {
            _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
            _baseUrl = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/');
            _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        }

        public void GoTo()
        {
            // Direct navigation to the report page
            _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl($"{_baseUrl}/admin/report");

            // Wait until the calendar is at least rendered (or just body ready)
            _wait.Until(_ => ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver)
                .ExecuteScript("return document.readyState")?.ToString() == "complete");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Waits for a booking event with exact text "FullName - Room: RoomName"
        /// and returns the IWebElement if found, or null on timeout.
        /// </summary>
        public IWebElement? WaitForBookingEvent(string guestFullName, string roomName, int timeoutSeconds = 20)
        {
            var expectedText = $"{guestFullName} - Room: {roomName}";
            var localWait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

            try
            {
                return localWait.Until(d =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var events = d.FindElements(_bookingEventContent);
                        return events.FirstOrDefault(e =>
                            e.Displayed &&
                            string.Equals(e.Text.Trim(), expectedText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        return null;
                    }
                });
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}
This POM:

Navigates to /admin/report,
Uses .rbc-event-content (from your HTML) to find events like James Dean - Room: 101,
Exposes WaitForBookingEvent(fullName, roomName).
2) Integration test: create booking via API, verify in UI
Below is a test class (or just the method) that uses:

AutomationTestingAuthClient and BookingClient from Arancia.Test.API.Clients,
Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase from Arancia.Test.API.Helpers,
BookingFactory.CreateRandomBooking() (from wherever you defined it in UI or API),
AdminAuthPage POM for login,
AdminReportPage POM to verify.
csharp

Collapse


 Copy

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using Arancia.Test.API.Clients;
using Arancia.Test.API.Helpers;
using FluentAssertions;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;
using UI.Tests.Fixture;
using UI.Tests.Helpers;       // BookingFactory if you created it here
using UI.Tests.Pages;
using Xunit;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

public class AdminReportIntegrationTests : IClassFixture<WebDriverFixture>
{
    private readonly WebDriverFixture _fix;
    private readonly ITestOutputHelper _output;
    private readonly AdminAuthPage _adminAuth;
    private readonly AdminReportPage _adminReport;
    private readonly string _baseUrl = "https://automationintesting.online";

    public AdminReportIntegrationTests(WebDriverFixture fix, ITestOutputHelper output)
    {
        _fix = fix ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(fix));
        _output = output ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(output));
        _adminAuth = new AdminAuthPage(_fix.Driver, _baseUrl);
        _adminReport = new AdminReportPage(_fix.Driver, _baseUrl);
    }

    [Fact(DisplayName = "INT-21 - Booking created via API is visible in Admin Report UI")]
    public async Task BookingCreatedViaApi_IsVisible_InAdminReport()
    {
        // ARRANGE (API) – create booking via API
        var apiBase = Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase;
        var bookingClient = new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(apiBase));

        // We know from earlier JSON that roomid 1 == RoomName "101"
        const int targetRoomId = 1;
        const string targetRoomName = "101";

        var booking = BookingFactory.CreateRandomBooking(); // or CreateRandomBooking from your TestBase
        booking.roomid = targetRoomId;

        // Use near-future dates so they appear on default view of the calendar
        var checkin = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(1);
        var checkout = checkin.AddDays(2);
        booking.bookingdates!.checkin = checkin.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
        booking.bookingdates!.checkout = checkout.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");

        var apiCreateResp = await bookingClient.CreateBookingAsync(booking);
        BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(_output, "POST /booking (INT-21)", apiCreateResp);
        ((int)apiCreateResp.StatusCode).Should().BeOneOf(200, 201, "booking must be created successfully via API");

        using var apiDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(apiCreateResp.Content!);
        apiDoc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("bookingid", out var idEl).Should().BeTrue();
        var bookingId = idEl.GetInt32();

        var fullName = $"{booking.firstname} {booking.lastname}";

        // ACT (UI) – login as admin and go to Report
        _adminAuth.GoToLogin();
        _adminAuth.LoginAsAdmin();
        _adminReport.GoTo();

        // ASSERT – booking appears in Report UI
        var evt = _adminReport.WaitForBookingEvent(fullName, targetRoomName, timeoutSeconds: 25);
        if (evt == null)
        {
            // capture artifacts on failure
            var ts = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
            try
            {
                var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_fix.Driver).GetScreenshot();
                var screenshotFile = $"int21_booking_report_not_found_{ts}.png";
                System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(screenshotFile, ss.AsByteArray);
                _output.WriteLine($"Saved screenshot: {screenshotFile}");
            }
            catch (Exception se) { _output.WriteLine($"Screenshot failed: {se.Message}"); }

            try
            {
                var pageFile = $"int21_booking_report_not_found_{ts}.html";
                System.IO.File.WriteAllText(pageFile, _fix.Driver.PageSource);
                _output.WriteLine($"Saved page source: {pageFile}");
            }
            catch (Exception pe) { _output.WriteLine($"Save page source failed: {pe.Message}"); }

            throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException(
                $"Expected booking '{fullName} - Room: {targetRoomName}' to appear in Admin Report UI, but it was not found.");
        }

        evt.Should().NotBeNull("booking event created via API should be visible in Admin Report UI");
        evt!.Text.Trim().Should().Be($"{fullName} - Room: {targetRoomName}");

        // TEARDOWN – delete booking via API (best-effort)
        try
        {
            var adminAuthApi = new AutomationTestingAuthClient();
            var adminToken = await adminAuthApi.GetTokenAsync("admin", "password");
            var delResp = await bookingClient.DeleteBookingAsync(bookingId, adminToken);
            _output.WriteLine($"Cleanup DELETE /booking/{bookingId} => {(int)delResp.StatusCode} - {delResp.StatusCode}");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _output.WriteLine($"Cleanup booking {bookingId} failed: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}
Points to adjust:
BookingFactory: if you don’t have it in UI.Tests, you can call CreateRandomBooking() from your API TestBase, or replicate the method (as you already did earlier).
Room mapping: this test assumes roomid = 1 → roomName = "101". If your environment changes, adjust targetRoomId / targetRoomName.
Dates vs. calendar view: if the report view uses a specific week/month by default, adjust checkin/checkout to land inside that view.
Selectors: if your report page uses a different structure, keep .rbc-event-content but tweak the match logic inside WaitForBookingEvent.
If you’d like, I can also add a small helper in the POM to navigate the calendar to the specific checkin date (e.g., next/prev buttons) before searching for the event.

Argumento 3: não é possível converter de "string" para "int"
linha do erro:         ((int)apiCreateResp.StatusCode).Should().BeOneOf(200, 201, "booking must be created successfully via API");

BeOneOf on an int doesn’t take a because string after the values the way you’re calling it, so the compiler is trying to treat the "booking must be..." as a third int.

Use one of these patterns instead:

Option 1 — use BeOneOf with an array + because
csharp

Collapse


 Copy

((int)apiCreateResp.StatusCode)
    .Should()
    .BeOneOf(new[] { 200, 201 }, "booking must be created successfully via API");
Option 2 — use BeInRange
csharp

Collapse


 Copy

((int)apiCreateResp.StatusCode)
    .Should()
    .BeInRange(200, 201, "booking must be created successfully via API");
Option 3 — use the enum directly
csharp

Collapse


 Copy

apiCreateResp.StatusCode
    .Should()
    .BeOneOf(HttpStatusCode.OK, HttpStatusCode.Created);
Pick one of these and the compile error will go away.

esse metodo de teste está criando sempre com a mesma data e quarto, causando conflito na hora de criar um novo booking. precisa alterar para sempre datas diferentes quando for executado.

You’re right: reusing the same room and a narrow fixed date window makes it easy to hit 409 conflicts as the environment accumulates bookings. The safest fix is to randomize the dates (and, optionally, spread them into the future) so each test run uses a unique, non-overlapping date range.

Here’s how to adjust the test:

Keep the same roomid (e.g., 1 → room 101).
Generate random offset + length so checkin/checkout vary each run.
Use those dates when building the booking.
Replace the “Choose conflicting dates” part in your test with something like this:

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

// Choose a random, non-overlapping future date window for this run
var rnd = new Random();

// Pick a random offset in days from today (e.g. 5–60 days ahead)
var offsetDays = rnd.Next(5, 61);

// Pick a random length for the stay (2–5 nights)
var lengthDays = rnd.Next(2, 6);

var checkin = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(offsetDays);
var checkout = checkin.AddDays(lengthDays);

// Apply to bookingdates
booking.bookingdates!.checkin = checkin.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
booking.bookingdates!.checkout = checkout.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
Full context inside the test (key part only):

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

// ARRANGE (API) – create booking via API
var apiBase = Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase;
var bookingClient = new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(apiBase));

const int targetRoomId = 1;
const string targetRoomName = "101";

var booking = BookingFactory.CreateRandomBooking();
booking.roomid = targetRoomId;

// random future date window to avoid conflicts
var rnd = new Random();
var offsetDays = rnd.Next(5, 61);   // 5 to 60 days in the future
var lengthDays = rnd.Next(2, 6);    // 2 to 5 nights
var checkin = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(offsetDays);
var checkout = checkin.AddDays(lengthDays);

booking.bookingdates!.checkin = checkin.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
booking.bookingdates!.checkout = checkout.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");

var apiCreateResp = await bookingClient.CreateBookingAsync(booking);
// assertion updated to not pass string as int:
apiCreateResp.StatusCode.Should().BeOneOf(HttpStatusCode.OK, HttpStatusCode.Created);

// ... rest of the test uses the same fullName and targetRoomName ...
If the report calendar view only shows a specific week/month, you might want to constrain offsetDays to land inside that view (e.g. 0–7 days ahead if the default shows the current week). Then you’re trading off a bit of conflict risk vs. visibility; you can always:

Keep the date random within a small range, and
If the first create returns 409, regenerate new dates and retry once.
But the simplest first step is the random future window shown above, which will eliminate conflicts in almost all normal runs.

user-image
o nosso assert esta vausando um falso negativo, pois o booking foi para o dia 2026-04-04 e quando a gente acessa a pagina Report ela entra no mes de Fevereiro, se voce navegar até o mes de Abril o registro vai aparecer.
como a gente pode contornar isso? tem um botão que navega pelos meses que no caso é o Next dentro desse html - <span class="rbc-btn-group"><button type="button">Today</button><button type="button">Back</button><button type="button">Next</button></span>

The false negative makes sense: the event exists, but the report calendar initially shows a different month (e.g., February) while the booking is in April. You need to navigate the calendar (via the “Next” button) until the month containing your booking is visible, then assert the event.

A clean way is to extend AdminReportPage with:

A method to read the currently displayed month/year from the calendar header.
A method to click “Next” until the target check-in month/year is reached (with a safety limit).
Then call WaitForBookingEvent only after the calendar is on the correct month.
Below is how you can implement this.

1) Extend AdminReportPage
Add these members to your existing AdminReportPage class.

csharp

Collapse


 Copy

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using OpenQA.Selenium;
using OpenQA.Selenium.Support.UI;

namespace UI.Tests.Pages
{
    public class AdminReportPage
    {
        private readonly IWebDriver _driver;
        private readonly WebDriverWait _wait;
        private readonly string _baseUrl;

        private static readonly By _bookingEventContent = By.CssSelector(".rbc-event-content");
        private static readonly By _calendarHeader      = By.CssSelector(".rbc-toolbar-label");
        private static readonly By _nextButton          = By.XPath("//span[contains(@class,'rbc-btn-group')]/button[normalize-space()='Next']");
        private static readonly By _backButton          = By.XPath("//span[contains(@class,'rbc-btn-group')]/button[normalize-space()='Back']");

        public AdminReportPage(IWebDriver driver, string baseUrl, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
        {
            _driver = driver ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(driver));
            _baseUrl = baseUrl.TrimEnd('/');
            _wait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, timeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        }

        public void GoTo()
        {
            _driver.Navigate().GoToUrl($"{_baseUrl}/admin/report");
            _wait.Until(_ => ((IJavaScriptExecutor)_driver).ExecuteScript("return document.readyState")?.ToString() == "complete");
            // wait for calendar toolbar header to be visible
            _wait.Until(d =>
            {
                try
                {
                    var el = d.FindElements(_calendarHeader).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                    return el != null;
                }
                catch { return false; }
            });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Parses the current calendar month/year from the toolbar label (e.g. "April 2026").
        /// </summary>
        public (int year, int month) GetCurrentMonthYear()
        {
            var labelEl = _wait.Until(d =>
            {
                try
                {
                    return d.FindElements(_calendarHeader).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                }
                catch { return null; }
            });

            if (labelEl == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not find calendar header label on Admin Report page.");

            var text = labelEl.Text.Trim(); // e.g. "April 2026"
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Calendar header label is empty.");

            // Expected format: "MMMM yyyy"
            if (!DateTime.TryParseExact(text, "MMMM yyyy", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var dt))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unable to parse calendar header '{text}' as 'MMMM yyyy'.");

            return (dt.Year, dt.Month);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Navigates the calendar using Next/Back until the target month/year is displayed,
        /// or until maxSteps is reached.
        /// </summary>
        public void NavigateToMonth(DateTime targetDate, int maxSteps = 24)
        {
            var targetYear  = targetDate.Year;
            var targetMonth = targetDate.Month;

            for (int i = 0; i < maxSteps; i++)
            {
                var (curYear, curMonth) = GetCurrentMonthYear();
                if (curYear == targetYear && curMonth == targetMonth)
                    return;

                // decide direction: if target is after current, click Next; else click Back
                if (new DateTime(targetYear, targetMonth, 1) > new DateTime(curYear, curMonth, 1))
                {
                    // click Next
                    var nextBtn = _driver.FindElements(_nextButton).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed && e.Enabled);
                    if (nextBtn == null)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Next button not found on calendar toolbar.");
                    nextBtn.Click();
                }
                else
                {
                    // click Back
                    var backBtn = _driver.FindElements(_backButton).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed && e.Enabled);
                    if (backBtn == null)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Back button not found on calendar toolbar.");
                    backBtn.Click();
                }

                // small wait for UI to update the month
                _wait.Until(d =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var lbl = d.FindElements(_calendarHeader).FirstOrDefault(e => e.Displayed);
                        return lbl != null;
                    }
                    catch { return false; }
                });
            }

            throw new TimeoutException($"Could not navigate calendar to {targetDate:MMMM yyyy} within {maxSteps} steps.");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Waits for a booking event with exact text "FullName - Room: RoomName"
        /// and returns the IWebElement if found, or null on timeout.
        /// </summary>
        public IWebElement? WaitForBookingEvent(string guestFullName, string roomName, int timeoutSeconds = 20)
        {
            var expectedText = $"{guestFullName} - Room: {roomName}";
            var localWait = new WebDriverWait(_driver, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeoutSeconds));

            try
            {
                return localWait.Until(d =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var events = d.FindElements(_bookingEventContent);
                        return events.FirstOrDefault(e =>
                            e.Displayed &&
                            string.Equals(e.Text.Trim(), expectedText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        return null;
                    }
                });
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}

This way, regardless of the initial month the calendar opens on (February, current month, etc.), the test:

Reads the current calendar month/year.
Clicks “Next” or “Back” until it reaches the month of the checkin date.
Only then searches for the event text Firstname Lastname - Room: 101.

[Fact(DisplayName = "INT-21 - Booking created via API is visible in Admin Report UI")]
public async Task BookingCreatedViaApi_IsVisible_InAdminReport()
{
    // ARRANGE – create booking via API
    var apiBase = Settings.AutomationTestingApiBase;
    var bookingClient = new BookingClient(ApiClientFactory.Create(apiBase));

    // Known mapping: roomid 1 == RoomName "101" (from earlier API responses)
    const int targetRoomId = 1;
    const string targetRoomName = "101";

    var booking = BookingFactory.CreateRandomBooking();
    booking.roomid = targetRoomId;

    // Use a near-future date so it is easy to navigate to that month
    var rnd = new Random();
    var offsetDays = rnd.Next(5, 31);         // 5–30 days from today
    var lengthDays = rnd.Next(2, 6);          // 2–5 nights
    var checkin = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(offsetDays);
    var checkout = checkin.AddDays(lengthDays);

    booking.bookingdates!.checkin = checkin.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
    booking.bookingdates!.checkout = checkout.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");

    var apiCreateResp = await bookingClient.CreateBookingAsync(booking);
    BookingTestHelper.LogRequestResponse(_output, "POST /booking (INT-21)", apiCreateResp);
    apiCreateResp.StatusCode.Should().BeOneOf(HttpStatusCode.OK, HttpStatusCode.Created);

    using var apiDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(apiCreateResp.Content!);
    apiDoc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("bookingid", out var idEl).Should().BeTrue();
    var bookingId = idEl.GetInt32();
    var fullName = $"{booking.firstname} {booking.lastname}";

    // ACT – login as admin and go to Report via nav menu
    _adminAuth.GoToLogin();
    _adminAuth.LoginAsAdmin();
    _adminReport.ClickReport();        // assumes implementation clicks the "Report" nav link

    // Ensure the calendar is on the month of the checkin date
    _adminReport.NavigateToMonth(checkin);

    // ASSERT – booking appears as an event "FullName - Room: 101"
    var evt = _adminReport.WaitForBookingEvent(fullName, targetRoomName, timeoutSeconds: 30);
    if (evt == null)
    {
        // capture artifacts for triage
        var ts = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
        try
        {
            var ss = ((ITakesScreenshot)_fix.Driver).GetScreenshot();
            var screenshotFile = $"int21_booking_report_not_found_{ts}.png";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes(screenshotFile, ss.AsByteArray);
            _output.WriteLine($"Saved screenshot: {screenshotFile}");
        }
        catch (Exception se) { _output.WriteLine($"Screenshot failed: {se.Message}"); }

        try
        {
            var pageFile = $"int21_booking_report_not_found_{ts}.html";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText(pageFile, _fix.Driver.PageSource);
            _output.WriteLine($"Saved page source: {pageFile}");
        }
        catch (Exception pe) { _output.WriteLine($"Save page source failed: {pe.Message}"); }

        try
        {
            var logs = new List<string>();
            var entries = _fix.Driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(LogType.Browser);
            logs.AddRange(entries.Select(e => $"{e.Timestamp} {e.Level} {e.Message}"));
            var logFile = $"int21_booking_report_not_found_{ts}_console.log";
            System.IO.File.WriteAllLines(logFile, logs);
            _output.WriteLine($"Saved console logs: {logFile}");
        }
        catch (Exception le) { _output.WriteLine($"Collect console logs failed: {le.Message}"); }

        throw new Xunit.Sdk.XunitException(
            $"Expected booking '{fullName} - Room: {targetRoomName}' to appear in Admin Report UI, but it was not found.");
    }

    evt.Should().NotBeNull("booking event created via API should be visible in Admin Report UI");
    evt!.Text.Trim().Should().Be($"{fullName} - Room: {targetRoomName}");

    // TEARDOWN – delete booking via API (best-effort)
    try
    {
        var adminAuthApi = new AutomationTestingAuthClient();
        var adminToken = await adminAuthApi.GetTokenAsync("admin", "password");
        var delResp = await bookingClient.DeleteBookingAsync(bookingId, adminToken);
        _output.WriteLine($"Cleanup DELETE /booking/{bookingId} => {(int)delResp.StatusCode} - {delResp.StatusCode}");
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _output.WriteLine($"Cleanup booking {bookingId} failed: {ex.Message}");
    }
}
Key points:

Uses random future dates in a reasonable window (offsetDays) to avoid conflicts but still be reachable by clicking “Next” a few times.
After login it calls _adminReport.ClickReport() as you requested (your POM should click the <a id="reportLink" ...>).
Calls _adminReport.NavigateToMonth(checkin) to move the calendar to the month of the booking.
Uses WaitForBookingEvent(fullName, "101") to assert the event exists.
On failure, captures screenshot, page source, and console logs for debugging, then fails the test with a clear message.
Cleans up the booking via API afterwards.

1. Introduction
This document outlines the testing strategy for the Restful-Booker Platform, a full-stack application for hotel reservation management. The goal is to ensure business logic reliability (API) and a seamless user experience (UI) through a Shift-Left approach.
2. Scope & Assumptions
In-Scope: Authentication flows, Booking management (Create/Read/Delete), and Admin dashboard interactions.
Out-of-Scope: Load testing, payment gateway simulations, and cross-browser testing for legacy browsers (IE).
Assumptions: The demo environment is stable and the API follows RESTful standards.
3. Identified Risks & Mitigation
Data Flakiness: Parallel tests might interfere with shared resources (e.g., deleting a booking another test is reading).
Mitigation: Use unique data for each test run and isolated sessions.
Environment Stability: Being an open-source demo, the server might go down.
Mitigation: Implement a "Health Check" test as the first step of the CI/CD pipeline.
Token Expiration: Administrative tasks require a session cookie.
Mitigation: Implement an automated Auth-helper to refresh tokens before secure tests.
4. Testing Pyramid & Prioritization
Following the Testing Pyramid, the effort will be distributed as follows:
API Tests (70%): Validating all HTTP status codes, JSON schemas, and business rules (e.g., mandatory fields).
UI Tests (30%): Validating the "Golden Path" (End-to-End) from the customer's perspective and the Admin's login flow.
Rationale: API tests provide faster feedback and are less expensive to maintain.
5. Tools & Frameworks
Language: C# (.NET 8/10)
Backend Testing: RestSharp + xUnit + FluentAssertions.
Frontend Testing: Selenium WebDriver (chosen for its industry-standard stability and POM support).
CI/CD: GitHub Actions.
Documentation: Markdown for test cases and bug reports.
6. Test Scenarios & Coverage Matrix
The following scenarios represent the core business logic and critical user journeys. Detailed step-by-step instructions for each can be found in the [ManualTestCases.md](./ManualTestCases.md) file.

| ID | Component | Scenario Description | Priority | Automation Status |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **API-01** | Auth | Validate successful admin login and token generation | P1 (Critical) | Automated |
| **API-02** | Booking | Create a new booking with valid dynamic data | P1 (Critical) | Automated |
| **API-03** | Booking | Attempt to delete a booking without a valid token | P2 (High) | Automated |
| **UI-01** | Booking | Complete room booking flow via homepage | P1 (Critical) | Automated |
| **UI-02** | Admin | Admin login and message inbox validation | P2 (High) | Manual |
| **UI-03** | Contact | Validate mandatory fields in the contact form | P3 (Medium) | Manual |
